items.title: 《巴隆》：Meta拚提前籌資逾400億美元投入AI 波克夏成潛在買家
items.title_en: Baron: Meta Pushes to Raise Over $40 B Early for AI, Berkshire May Be Potential Buyer
paras: 《巴隆週刊》週四 (22 日) 報導，Meta (META-US) 為支應龐大的人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資，最快可能在未來幾週啟動至少 400 億美元的股權募資，搶在其他科技企業進場前取得資金。手握逾 3,500 億美元現金的波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 可能成為潛在買家，但目前並無雙方洽談或波克夏確定參與的消息。
Meta 加速籌資的背景，是 AI 支出與債務負擔持續增加。公司今年資本支出預估約 1,400 億美元，長期債務今年以來增加 220 億美元，達到 800 億美元，另有龐大的表外融資承諾。
投資人對 Meta 融資需求的疑慮，也推升其借貸成本。公司 30 年期債券殖利率已突破 7%，對信用評等達 AA 級的企業而言處於偏高水準。透過發行新股取得資金，可望降低公司對債務融資的依賴。
Meta 在週三提交的文件中指出，最快自 2026 年秋季起，未來數年可能需要籌措數千億美元。
公司形容，資本募集環境「日益嚴峻」，認為在更多企業吸收市場可用資金之前，提前籌資將是審慎之舉。
科技業的資金競爭正是考量之一。Anthropic 預計不久後提交首次公開發行 (IPO) 申請文件，並可能在感恩節前進行大規模上市募資，增加 Meta 提前行動的誘因。
為擴大股權融資空間，Meta 週三公布財報時宣布，將設立不具投票權的 C 類普通股。
祖克柏目前透過未上市的超級投票權股份，掌握約 60% 投票權，經濟持股比重則約為 14%。未來若發行無投票權新股籌資，可避免稀釋其投票權，但仍會稀釋原股東的經濟持股比重。
依規劃，Meta 將於 2027 年 1 月，按每持有 1 股配發 1 股新 C 類股的方式，將新股分配給現有股東，效果類似 1 股拆為 2 股。
華爾街起初因此預期，公司可能等到明年 1 月才啟動股權募資，但最新文件透露的資金需求，讓市場開始預期時程可能提前。
摩根大通分析師 Doug Anmuth 認為，Meta 越早完成股權募資越好，有助消除市場對潛在新股供給的疑慮。
他指出，即使在新 C 類股配發前，公司仍有空間進行大規模股權募資，而不至於明顯影響祖克柏的投票控制權。
Evercore 分析師 Mark Mahaney 則估計，Meta 未來 3 至 6 個月可能透過股權與債務融資，合計籌措 500 億至 1,000 億美元。
這項估算涵蓋不同融資管道，與報導提出至少 400 億美元的潛在股權募資規模不同。
至於潛在投資者，波克夏參與 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 募資的案例，可能成為 Meta 的參考。
今年 6 月，Alphabet 進行規模 850 億美元的股權募資，波克夏以較市價折讓 6% 的價格，買進合計 100 億美元的具投票權及無投票權股份。
報導分析， 阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 接替巴菲特出任執行長後，波克夏仍持有逾 3,500 億美元現金，尋找資金配置機會。Meta 目前股價相當於不到 20 倍的 2026 年預估每股盈餘，為科技七巨頭中估值較低的公司之一，獲利仍維持雙位數年增率，可能符合波克夏重視價格與企業獲利能力的投資取向。
不過，波克夏是否參與仍屬報導分析，Meta 也尚未公布此次募資的確切金額、時程或發行條件。Meta 週四股價下跌 6.98%，收每股 648.85 美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that Meta (META-US) may launch an equity raise of at least $40 billion within the next few weeks to fund its massive AI infrastructure investments, aiming to secure capital before other tech firms enter the market. Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US), which holds over $350 billion in cash, could be a potential buyer, though there are no reports of talks or confirmed participation from Berkshire at this time.

The backdrop to Meta’s accelerated fundraising is the continued rise in AI spending and debt burden. The company’s capital expenditures this year are projected at roughly $140 billion, while long‑term debt has risen by $22 billion to $80 billion, alongside a large off‑balance‑sheet financing commitment.

Investor concerns about Meta’s financing needs have also pushed up its borrowing costs. The yield on its 30‑year bond has broken 7%, a relatively high level for a company with an AA credit rating. Raising cash through a new equity issuance could reduce the firm’s reliance on debt financing.
In a filing submitted on Wednesday, Meta indicated that as early as the fall of 2026, it may need to raise several hundred billion dollars over the next few years.
The company described the capital‑raising environment as “increasingly challenging,” saying that securing funds ahead of other firms that will soak up market liquidity is a prudent move.

Competition for capital in the tech sector is a key consideration. Anthropic is expected to file for an IPO soon and may conduct a large public offering before Thanksgiving, adding incentive for Meta to act early.
To broaden its equity‑raising capacity, Meta announced on Wednesday, alongside its earnings release, that it will create a non‑voting Class C common share.

Zuckerberg currently controls about 60% of voting power through unlisted super‑voting shares, while his economic stake is roughly 14%. Issuing non‑voting new shares would avoid diluting his voting power but would still dilute existing shareholders’ economic interests.
According to the plan, in January 2027 Meta will distribute one new Class C share for each existing share held, effectively a 1‑for‑2 split.
Wall Street initially expected the company might wait until January next year to start an equity raise, but the latest filing’s funding needs have led the market to anticipate an earlier timeline.
JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said the sooner Meta completes an equity raise, the better, as it would help allay market concerns about a potential new‑share supply.
He noted that even before the new Class C shares are allocated, the company still has room to conduct a large‑scale equity raise without materially affecting Zuckerberg’s voting control.
Evercore analyst Mark Mahaney estimates that over the next three to six months Meta could raise between $50 billion and $100 billion through a combination of equity and debt financing.
That estimate covers various financing channels and differs from the report’s suggestion of at least $40 billion in potential equity proceeds.
As for potential investors, Berkshire’s participation in Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) financing could serve as a reference for Meta.
In June, Alphabet carried out an $85 billion equity raise, and Berkshire bought $10 billion of voting and non‑voting shares at a 6% discount to market price.

The analysis notes that after Greg Abel succeeded Warren Buffett as CEO, Berkshire still holds over $350 billion in cash and is looking for allocation opportunities. Meta’s stock trades at less than 20 times its projected 2026 earnings per share, making it one of the lower‑valued among the seven big tech firms, with double‑digit annual profit growth, which may fit Berkshire’s focus on price and profitability.

Whether Berkshire will actually participate remains speculative; Meta has not disclosed the exact amount, timing or terms of the planned raise. Meta’s shares fell 6.98% on Thursday, closing at $648.85 per share.

items.title: 二次暴倉在即？7月剛被強平 9月又押錯方向　華爾街「AI股神」再陷倉位危機
items.title_en: Second Margin Call Looms? Forced Liquidation in July, Wrong Bet Again in September – Wall Street’s “AI Stock God” Faces Position Crisis
paras: 曾被華爾街捧為「AI股神」的25歲避險基金經理Leopold Aschenbrenner，旗下基金Situational Awareness今年7月遭遇強平危機後，9月初重建的AI股多頭倉位近期再度承压，市場關注其看漲選擇權部位是否面臨權利金歸零風險。
Aschenbrenner曾任OpenAI「超級對齊」團隊研究員，2024年發表165頁長文《Situational Awareness》預言AI算力將吞噬晶片、記憶體與電力，隨後在舊金山成立同名基金，獲矽谷與華爾街資金追捧。其策略始終明確，重押閃迪與美光等記憶體股，押注大模型訓練帶動HBM與企業級NAND需求。
上述策略在今年上半年大賺，基金年內報酬率一度達439%，資產規模衝上450億美元，但轉折發生在今年7月下旬。美股AI硬體族群出現約兩成技術性回檔，在約4倍融資槓桿下，股價跌兩成即意味本金清零，摩根大通等重量級經紀商發出追加保證金通知並收緊信貸額度，基金被迫低價拋售持倉。
13F文件顯示，截至6月底基金美股多頭約202億美元，其中持有閃迪約57億、美光約56億，兩股合佔逾半數，強平數日內基金淨值回撤約67%，大批核心部位以約五成折讓轉讓給城堡證券(Citadel)。諷刺的是，8月相關硬體股強勁反彈，他卻已出局。
在7月致歉信中，Aschenbrenner承諾移除槓桿、改以自有資金或全額支付期權操作。上月初，Aschenbrenner轉與經紀商Clear Street合作，投入數億美元權利金買入超微、英特爾、SK海力士、SanDisk、CoreWeave等看漲選擇權，最大虧損鎖定在權利金內，券商無法盤中強平。
但選擇權引入「時間」變數。自9月建倉以來，七檔核心標的平均回跌18.3%，CoreWeave跌逾三分之一，SK海力士與閃迪跌約四分之一，現貨持有者能「躺平」等解套，選擇權卻因遠離履約價、時間價值流失而迅速萎縮；若到期前未大漲，權利金將歸零。
市場分析指出，Situational Awareness的兩次危機並非產業判斷錯誤，而是二級市場博弈邏輯不同。當基金槓桿、持倉與到期結構暴露在明處，倉位本身會成為對手盤打壓流動性的依據。數學與程式面對的是規則固定的世界，盤面價格卻是資金期限與人性博弈的結果。
隨著下月中第三季13F持倉報告即將發布，市場將確認這批選擇權真實規模。無論數字為何，Aschenbrenner三個內二度「高台跳水」已成一則樣本：數據能推演產業遠方，但價格從來只反映當下人心。
paras_en: 25-year-old hedge fund manager Leopold Aschenbrenner, once hailed by Wall Street as the “AI Stock God,” saw his Situational Awareness fund hit a forced‑liquidation crisis in July; the AI‑long position he rebuilt in early September is now under pressure again, and the market is watching whether his bullish options exposure faces the risk of premium decay to zero.

Aschenbrenner previously worked on OpenAI’s “super alignment” team and in 2024 published a 165‑page paper titled “Situational Awareness” predicting that AI compute would devour chips, memory and power. He then launched a fund of the same name in San Francisco, attracting Silicon Valley and Wall Street capital. His strategy has been clear‑cut: heavily overweight memory‑chip makers such as Micron and SK Hynix, betting that large‑model training will drive demand for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND.

The strategy paid off handsomely in the first half of the year, with the fund’s annual return soaring to 439% and assets swelling to $45 billion, but the tide turned in late July. The U.S. AI‑hardware sector suffered roughly a 20% technical pull‑back; with about 4‑times leverage, a 20% price drop meant the capital was wiped out. Major brokers such as JPMorgan issued margin calls and tightened credit lines, forcing the fund to sell holdings at distressed prices.

13F filings show that as of the end of June the fund’s U.S. long exposure was about $20.2 billion, including roughly $5.7 billion in Micron and $5.6 billion in SK Hynix – together more than half of the portfolio. Within days of the forced liquidation the fund’s net asset value fell about 67%, and large core positions were sold to Citadel at roughly a 50% discount. Ironically, the hardware stocks rebounded strongly in August, but Aschenbrenner was already out of the game.

In a July apology letter, Aschenbrenner pledged to remove leverage and fund options trades with his own capital or pay the full premium up front. In early September he partnered with broker Clear Street, spending several hundred million dollars in premiums to buy call options on AMD, Intel, SK Hynix, SanDisk, CoreWeave and others, capping any loss at the premium paid and preventing intraday forced liquidation by the broker.

However, options introduce a time dimension. Since the September build‑up, the seven core underlyings have fallen an average of 18.3%; CoreWeave is down more than a third, SK Hynix and Micron each about a quarter. While spot holders can wait for a rebound, the options have rapidly lost value as they moved away from the strike and shed time value; if the stocks do not surge before expiry, the premiums will evaporate to zero.

Analysts note that the two crises at Situational Awareness were not due to misreading the industry but to different dynamics in the secondary market. When a fund’s leverage, position size and expiry profile are exposed, the position itself becomes a lever for opponents to squeeze liquidity. Mathematics and code operate in a rule‑bound world, whereas market prices reflect the interplay of capital horizons and human psychology.

With the Q3 13F filing due next month, the market will soon see the true scale of these options. Whatever the numbers, Aschenbrenner’s two “high‑board dives” in a short span serve as a case study: data can forecast industry trends far ahead, but prices only ever mirror the sentiment of the moment.

items.title: Meta財報亮眼卻遭股債雙殺！8250億美元承諾揭開AI投資真實代價
items.title_en: Meta’s Strong Earnings Yet Hit by a Stock‑Bond Double‑Whammy: $825 B Commitment Reveals the True Cost of AI Investment
paras: Meta (Meta Platforms) (META-US) 第三季財報原本帶動股價盤後一度大漲逾5%，但隔日卻出現股價重挫、信用風險指標飆升的股債雙殺。表面上，公司營收與第四季財測均優於市場預期，核心廣告業務維持強勁成長；然而，財報揭露的自由現金流轉負、AI基礎建設支出持續攀升，以及高達8,250億美元的租約與合約承諾，讓投資人開始重新評估這場AI競賽的資金成本與風險。
Meta第三季營收達646.01億美元，年增26%，高於市場預期的633.4億美元；公司預估第四季營收將達730億至760億美元，中位數745億美元，也高於市場共識的約736億至737億美元。若排除第三季98.9億美元的一次性法律和解費用，調整後每股盈餘約7.40美元，遠高於華爾街預估的6.08至6.54美元。
利多公布後，Meta股價在週三盤後一度升至737.70美元，相較當日收盤價697.52美元高出5.76%。然而，到了週四，市場焦點迅速從獲利能力轉向現金流、未來付款義務及融資需求。Meta股價盤中一度跌至648.26美元，從盤後高點回落約12.1%，市值一度蒸發逾1,000億美元，相關市場估算損失約達1,140億美元。
這場反轉的核心，在於兩張財務報表傳遞了不同訊號：損益表顯示Meta的廣告業務仍具備強勁的營收成長與變現能力；現金流量表及合約承諾則顯示，AI投資正迅速增加資金需求。市場並非突然認為Meta不再賺錢，而是開始質疑，即使核心業務持續成長，公司是否仍能單靠營運現金流支應未來數年的投資規模。
Meta第三季廣告營收達630.6億美元，年增26%。截至9月，旗下應用程式每日活躍使用者總數平均達36.4億人，年增3%；廣告曝光量年增10%，每則廣告平均價格上升14%。這些數據顯示，Meta的廣告推薦系統與定價能力仍在改善，並未出現核心業務失速的跡象。
不過，GAAP會計口徑下的獲利受到法律支出明顯拖累。Meta第三季總成本與費用達516.13億美元，年增68%；營業利益為129.88億美元，年減37%，營業利益率從去年同期的40%降至20%。淨利則達98.6億美元，年增264%，稀釋後每股盈餘為3.83美元，年增265%。淨利大幅成長部分受到去年同期有效稅率高達87%、本季降至24%的影響，不能直接解讀為核心獲利同步大幅改善。
Meta在第三季認列98.9億美元法律相關費用，源於公司與美國52名州檢察長就青少年心理健康及社群媒體相關訴訟達成協議。該協議涉及未來最高約185.9億美元的潛在支付。排除這筆費用後，第三季營業利益可由129.88億美元提高至228.8億美元，稀釋後每股盈餘則由3.83美元提高至7.40美元，顯示一次性法律支出確實影響了帳面獲利。
因此，財報的營運面並不是市場突然轉空的主要原因。真正引發疑慮的是，Meta為了擴建資料中心、採購AI伺服器及建置網路與能源基礎設施，所需投入的資金正快速增加，而且支出壓力已經反映在現金流上。
Meta第三季營運活動現金流為327.86億美元，但包含融資租賃本金付款的資本支出達349.1億美元，資本支出首次超過單季營運現金流，自由現金流因此轉為負21.2億美元。這也是公司自2012年以來首次出現單季自由現金流赤字，與去年同期正值106.3億美元、第二季正值7.84億美元形成明顯對比。
單季自由現金流轉負，本身未必代表企業財務結構已經惡化。大型資料中心的建置、伺服器採購與設備付款往往集中在特定季度，而廣告收入及現金回收相對平穩，兩者之間可能出現時間差。在資本支出快速增加的階段，季度自由現金流轉負確實可能只是支出節奏問題。
但Meta的情況不只如此。公司2026年全年資本支出預估由原先的1,300億至1,450億美元，調整為1,350億至1,450億美元，雖然上限沒有提高，下限卻增加50億美元，反映管理層對較高支出規模的預期更加明確。Meta同時預估全年總費用將達1,750億至1,790億美元，第四季營收指引則為730億至760億美元，並預期匯率將對營收年增率造成約1個百分點的逆風。
更令市場不安的是，Meta未來的資金承諾已遠遠超出單季或單年度的資本支出。根據公司第三季監管文件，截至9月30日，尚未起租的營運租約與融資租約義務約3,557.3億美元，主要涉及資料中心、能源相關設施、共置設施及部分網路基礎建設，相關租約預計自2026年剩餘期間起至2036年陸續啟動，租期從超過一年至30年不等。
此外，Meta還有約4,545.2億美元不可撤銷的短期與長期合約承諾，主要涉及第三方雲端容量、伺服器與網路設備、資料中心、能源服務協議，以及Reality Labs消費性硬體產品。公司另有五年內最高147.2億美元的雲端運算容量採購承諾，若供應商能將相關容量出售給其他客戶，部分義務可能減少。
將上述數字合計，Meta的租約與合約承諾約達8,250億美元，較今年7月市場掌握的約7,000億美元大幅增加。這些數字並不代表Meta已經借入8,250億美元，也不等同於全部已經到期的付款，而是公司已簽訂、尚未起租或尚未履約的未來義務。這些承諾不會全部立即列入資產負債表的長期債務，但仍可能在未來多年形成實際現金流出。

從時間變化來看，Meta今年3月底尚未起租的租約義務約1,828.8億美元，不可撤銷合約承諾約2,376.7億美元；截至6月底，相關租約義務已增至約2,789.9億美元，合約承諾則達約3,493.1億美元。7月公司又簽訂約680億美元的新資料中心租約，預計於2027年及2028年開始生效。到了9月底，尚未起租租約義務升至3,557.3億美元，合約承諾增加至4,545.2億美元，顯示AI基礎建設擴張不只推高當期支出，也持續鎖定未來資金。
付款時程同樣值得關注。Meta截至9月底的合約承諾中，約458.5億美元預計於2026年到期，2027年則約有1,214.1億美元到期，遠高於此前披露的2027年約816.5億美元。這代表公司未來一年的現金需求不只取決於新的資本支出決策，也受到先前已簽署合約的約束。
截至第三季末，Meta持有現金、約當現金及有價證券共824.5億美元，長期債務約809.2億美元。單看資產負債表，公司仍有大量流動性資產，債務規模也不至於直接導致短期償付危機；但若把8,250億美元的租約及合約承諾納入考量，便能看出未來現金需求遠大於帳面債務所呈現的壓力。

另一項結構性差異，是Meta不像微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US)、亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)及Alphabet旗下的Google Cloud，能直接向外部企業出售大量雲端算力。微軟可透過Azure、亞馬遜可透過AWS、Alphabet (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US)則可透過Google Cloud銷售運算容量，在部分情況下將基礎建設投資轉化為外部雲端服務收入。
Meta的AI基礎建設則主要服務自家產品與業務。若AI運算能力能改善Facebook與Instagram的推薦效率、提高廣告轉換率，或帶動Muse等新產品的商業化，這些投資便有機會透過廣告及新服務收入回收；但如果AI需求或產品變現速度不如預期，Meta便難以像雲端服務商一樣，單純將多餘算力出租給外部客戶。這使公司必須自行承擔更多投資回收風險。
信用市場率先反映了這種不確定性。Meta五年期信用違約交換 (CDS) 於週四上升7.6個基點至114.79個基點，創該指標的歷史新高，也是至少自2025年以來最大的單日漲幅之一。CDS是投資人用來對沖企業債務違約風險的金融工具，其價格上升代表市場要求更高的信用風險補償，但不等於市場認定企業即將違約。
Meta的廣告業務仍能產生大量營運現金流，手中也有超過820億美元的現金與有價證券，因此短期違約並非這次市場反應的核心。信用市場更在意的是，公司若持續擴大AI投資，未來是否需要透過更大規模的債券發行支應支出，以及新增融資的成本會上升多少。
債券市場也出現類似訊號。市場資料顯示，Meta一檔2036年到期、票面利率5.25%的債券，其風險溢價擴大約6個基點至120個基點。當企業信用利差走闊，代表投資人相較於同期限基準債券，要求更高的額外報酬。若Meta未來需要持續發債，較高的信用利差可能推升融資成本，並進一步影響AI投資的經濟效益。
巴克萊分析師Andrew Keches認為，Meta設立新股的安排，單獨來看至少具有正面意義，但監管文件揭露的支出規模也顯示，公司對AI基礎建設抱持極為積極的擴張計畫。他預期Meta近期可能發行債券，並指出，只要發債供給增加，信用利差便可能在一段時間內持續承壓。
信用風險上升也不只發生在Meta身上。甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US)與亞馬遜的五年期CDS同步接近或觸及高位，其他大型科技企業的信用指標也受到AI投資支出及融資需求影響。微軟、Alphabet與亞馬遜股價當日同樣走低，顯示市場正在重新評估整個AI產業的資本投入與資金回收模式，而非單純針對Meta的單一財報作出反應。
這場股債雙殺的另一個焦點，是Meta設立無投票權C類普通股。公司董事會於10月19日批准調整資本結構，並在10月20日取得所需股東書面同意，預計於2027年1月19日生效。依規畫，每一股現有A類及B類普通股將獲配一股C類普通股，配發的基準日與支付日期將由董事會另行決定。由於C類股不具投票權，這項安排預期可在維持原有投票權結構的情況下，擴大公司未來運用股票的彈性。
這項安排在形式上類似二比一股票分割，但兩者並不完全相同。一般股票分割是將既有股份拆分，股東持股比例及公司總市值不因分割本身改變；Meta的C類股則是新增一種無投票權股份，未來可用於員工薪酬、併購或籌集資本。這代表新股除了調整流通股結構，也可能成為公司日後取得外部資金的工具。
投資人擔心的是，當自由現金流已轉負、AI建設仍持續加速時，新股架構可能為未來股權融資預作準備。公司可以在不直接稀釋祖克柏投票控制權的前提下發行無投票權股票，但若未來實際發行大量新股，仍可能稀釋既有股東的經濟權益。換言之，維持控制權與避免股權稀釋是兩個不同問題。
Oppenheimer分析師估計，到2028年，AI及Muse相關投資可能使Meta累計自由現金流減少約1,350億美元，超過公司目前約900億美元的現金與有價證券規模。這是分析師情境估算，並非Meta官方公布的現金流預測，但反映市場擔心，若資本支出持續高於營運現金流所能支應的水準，公司最終可能必須更積極地使用債務或股權融資。
股權分析師與信用市場之所以出現不同判斷，主要是兩者觀察的時間尺度不同。股權市場重視未來數年AI投資能創造多少營收與獲利，信用市場則更關注近期付款義務、債券供給及再融資成本。只要投資人相信AI能長期提高廣告效率與企業價值，股價就可能在短期支出壓力下仍獲得支撐；但債券投資人必須先確認公司有能力支付近期到期款項，無法單靠多年後的成長預期評估信用風險。
部分華爾街機構仍維持對Meta的正面看法。巴克萊維持「加碼」評等，並將目標價由780美元調高至880美元；至少13家華爾街機構在財報後調高目標價。花旗則認為，Meta可能正進入AI產品的「超級週期」。相關看多論點聚焦於Muse的使用者成長、AI推薦技術對廣告定價的改善，以及新產品未來的商業化潛力。
Muse上線約一個半月後，北美使用者已超過1,000萬人，為Meta探索AI助理及新服務的商業模式提供初步基礎。若這類產品能帶動更多使用者參與、增加廣告變現機會，或發展出新的付費與交易收入，龐大基礎建設承諾便可能成為支持長期競爭力的投資，而不只是成本負擔。
但新產品使用者增加，不代表相關投資已經產生足夠回報。Meta仍需要證明AI服務能帶來持續的收入成長，並抵銷伺服器折舊、能源、資料中心租賃及研發支出。對股東而言，關鍵不只是AI產品能否吸引使用者，而是新增收入與利潤能否在合理時間內覆蓋資本成本。
股價技術面也反映市場信心的變化。Meta在2026年開盤價約648.74美元，週四盤中低點648.26美元幾乎回測年初水準。若股價持續守住648美元附近，市場仍可能將這次下跌視為AI支出疑慮引發的估值修正；若跌破該區間，則可能進一步測試600美元附近。反之，股價若要修復財報後的跌勢，至少需要重新站回週三收盤的697.52美元。這些價格只是技術觀察區間，並不代表股價必然朝特定方向發展。
接下來有三項指標值得追蹤。第一是Meta尚未公布的2027年資本支出計畫。如果明年支出仍快速增加，自由現金流轉負就可能從單季現象轉為較長期的資金壓力。第二是公司是否在近期發行債券，以及發行規模與利率條件，這將直接反映市場願意提供多少資金、公司需要支付多少融資成本。第三是2027年約1,214億美元的合約付款義務能否由營運現金流、既有資產與外部融資共同支應，而不至於持續侵蝕流動性。
Meta此次股債雙殺，並不代表其廣告業務已經失去競爭力。第三季營收年增26%、廣告價格年增14%，以及每日活躍使用者達36.4億人，都顯示核心業務仍有成長動能。真正的問題是，AI投資規模已大到足以改變市場對公司財務結構的評估：自由現金流14年來首次轉負，資本支出超過單季營運現金流，租約與合約承諾升至8,250億美元，新設C類股又增加了未來融資的可能性。
因此，這次市場反應更像是對AI資本支出模式的重新定價，而非對Meta營運前景的全面否定。股權投資人仍可能押注AI長期帶來的廣告效率與新產品收入，信用投資人則會先要求公司證明未來數年的現金流足以覆蓋支出與付款義務。在2027年資本支出規畫、債券發行條件及AI投資回報逐步明朗之前，這兩套敘事之間的落差，仍可能是Meta股價與信用利差波動的主要來源。
paras_en: Meta (Meta Platforms) (META‑US) posted a Q3 earnings report that initially sent the after‑hours stock up more than 5%, but the next day the shares plunged and credit‑risk metrics spiked, delivering a double‑whammy on both equity and debt. On the surface, revenue and Q4 guidance both beat market expectations and core ad business kept strong growth; however, the report disclosed negative free cash flow, rising AI‑infrastructure spending, and up to $825 billion of lease and contract commitments, prompting investors to reassess the capital cost and risk of the AI race.

Meta’s Q3 revenue hit $64.601 billion, up 26% year‑over‑year and above the market’s $63.34 billion forecast. The company projects Q4 revenue of $73.0‑$76.0 billion, with a midpoint of $74.5 billion, also topping the consensus range of roughly $73.6‑$73.7 billion. Excluding a one‑time $9.89 billion legal settlement charge, adjusted earnings per share were about $7.40, far above Wall Street’s $6.08‑$6.54 estimate.

After the good news, Meta’s stock rose in after‑hours trading on Wednesday to $737.70, 5.76% above the day’s close of $697.52. By Thursday, the market’s focus shifted quickly from profitability to cash flow, future payment obligations and financing needs. The share price fell intraday to $648.26, roughly a 12.1% drop from the after‑hours high, wiping out more than $100 billion in market value and an estimated $114 billion loss in related market calculations.

The reversal stems from two financial statements sending different signals: the income statement shows Meta’s ad business still delivering strong revenue growth and monetisation, while the cash‑flow statement and contract commitments reveal rapidly rising capital needs for AI. The market is not suddenly doubting Meta’s ability to earn money, but is questioning whether the company can fund several years of AI investment on operating cash alone despite continued core‑business growth.

Meta’s Q3 ad revenue reached $63.06 billion, up 26% YoY. As of September, the company’s apps averaged 3.64 billion daily active users, a 3% increase, with ad impressions up 10% and average price per ad up 14%. These figures show Meta’s ad recommendation system and pricing power are still improving, with no sign of a slowdown in the core business.

However, GAAP earnings were noticeably dragged down by legal expenses. Meta’s total Q3 costs and expenses rose 68% to $51.613 billion, yielding operating income of $12.988 billion, down 37% YoY, and an operating margin that fell from 40% a year ago to 20% now. Net income was $9.86 billion, up 264% YoY, with diluted EPS of $3.83, up 265% YoY. The net‑income surge reflects a drop in the effective tax rate from 87% last year to 24% this quarter and should not be read as a comparable rise in core profitability.

Meta recorded a $9.89 billion legal expense in Q3, stemming from settlements with attorneys general in 52 U.S. states over teen mental‑health and social‑media lawsuits. The agreement could involve up to about $18.59 billion in future payments. Excluding that charge, Q3 operating income would have risen to $22.88 billion and diluted EPS to $7.40, showing the one‑time legal cost materially depressed reported earnings.

Thus, the operating side of the earnings is not the primary driver of the market’s sudden bearish turn. The real concern is the rapidly escalating cash needed for data‑center expansion, AI‑server purchases and network‑and‑energy infrastructure, which is already reflected in cash‑flow pressure.

Meta’s Q3 cash flow from operations was $32.786 billion, but capital expenditures—including principal payments on finance leases—totaled $34.91 billion, marking the first quarter where capex exceeded operating cash flow. Free cash flow turned negative by $2.12 billion, the first quarterly deficit since 2012, contrasting with a positive $10.63 billion a year earlier and $0.784 billion in Q2.

A single quarter of negative free cash flow does not necessarily signal a deteriorating financial structure. Large data‑center builds, server purchases and equipment payments tend to cluster in certain quarters, while ad revenue and cash collections are steadier, creating timing mismatches. In a phase of rapidly rising capex, a negative quarterly free cash flow may simply reflect the spending rhythm.

Meta’s situation goes beyond timing. The company now expects full‑year 2026 capex of $135‑$145 billion (down from an earlier $130‑$145 billion range, with the lower bound raised by $5 billion), indicating management’s clearer view of a higher spending floor. Meta also forecasts total annual expenses of $175‑$179 billion and Q4 revenue guidance of $73‑$76 billion, while noting that currency effects could shave about one percentage point off revenue growth.

More unsettling is that Meta’s future funding commitments far exceed any single quarter or year’s capex. According to Q3 regulatory filings, as of September 30 there were about $355.73 billion of operating and finance lease obligations that have not yet commenced, mainly for data‑centers, energy facilities, colocation sites and some network infrastructure. These leases are slated to start between 2026 and 2036, with terms ranging from over a year to 30 years.

In addition, Meta has roughly $454.52 billion of irrevocable short‑ and long‑term contract commitments covering third‑party cloud capacity, servers and networking gear, data‑center services, energy‑service agreements and Reality Labs consumer‑hardware products. The company also holds a five‑year, up‑to‑$14.72 billion cloud‑capacity purchase commitment; if suppliers can resell that capacity to other customers, part of the obligation could be reduced.

Adding those figures together, Meta’s lease and contract commitments total about $825 billion, a sharp rise from the roughly $700 billion the market estimated in July. These numbers do not mean Meta has borrowed $825 billion, nor that all obligations are immediately due; they represent signed agreements that have not yet been activated or fulfilled. While they won’t all be recorded as long‑term debt on the balance sheet right away, they could generate real cash outflows over many years.

Looking at the timeline, by the end of March this year the not‑yet‑effective lease obligations were about $182.88 billion and irrevocable contract commitments about $237.67 billion. By June‑end they had risen to roughly $278.99 billion in lease obligations and $349.31 billion in contract commitments. In July the company signed about $68 billion of new data‑center leases slated to start in 2027‑2028. By September‑end, un‑started lease obligations climbed to $355.73 billion and contract commitments to $454.52 billion, showing AI‑infrastructure expansion is locking in future cash as well as current spending.

Payment timing is also noteworthy. Of the September‑end contract commitments, about $45.85 billion are due in 2026 and roughly $121.41 billion in 2027—well above the previously disclosed 2027 figure of $81.65 billion. This indicates that next year’s cash needs will be driven not only by new capex decisions but also by obligations already signed.

At the end of Q3, Meta held $82.45 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, with long‑term debt of about $80.92 billion. On a balance‑sheet basis the company still has ample liquidity and debt levels that do not pose an immediate repayment crisis; however, when the $825 billion of lease and contract commitments are taken into account, future cash requirements appear far larger than the pressure suggested by headline debt figures.

A structural difference is that Meta cannot monetize its infrastructure the way Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) or Alphabet’s Google Cloud can by selling large amounts of cloud compute to external customers. Microsoft does so via Azure, Amazon via AWS, and Alphabet via Google Cloud, turning some infrastructure spend into external service revenue.

Meta’s AI infrastructure primarily serves its own products and businesses. If AI compute improves recommendation efficiency on Facebook and Instagram, lifts ad conversion rates, or helps commercialise new products like Muse, the investments could be recouped through ad and new‑service revenue. But if AI demand or product monetisation falls short, Meta cannot simply lease excess compute to outsiders, forcing the company to bear more of the investment risk itself.

The credit market was the first to price in that uncertainty. Meta’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) rose 7.6 basis points on Thursday to 114.79 bps, a historic high and the biggest single‑day jump since at least 2025. CDS spreads reflect the premium investors demand for credit‑risk protection; a higher spread signals higher perceived default risk, though it does not mean a default is imminent.

Meta’s ad business still generates substantial operating cash flow and the firm holds over $82 billion in cash and marketable securities, so short‑term default is not the core issue behind the market reaction. Credit investors are more concerned about whether continued AI spending will force larger bond issuances and how much the cost of new financing will rise.

Bond market data show a similar signal. One of Meta’s 2036‑maturing bonds with a 5.25% coupon saw its risk premium widen by about six basis points to 120 bps. When a company’s credit spread widens, investors demand extra compensation relative to comparable‑maturity benchmark bonds. If Meta needs to keep issuing debt, higher spreads could lift financing costs and erode the economics of AI investment.

Barclays analyst Andrew Keches believes the new‑share arrangement has at least a positive aspect on its own, but the disclosed spending scale shows Meta is pursuing an aggressive AI‑infrastructure expansion. He expects Meta may issue bonds soon and notes that as bond supply increases, credit spreads could stay under pressure for a while.

Rising credit risk is not limited to Meta. Oracle (ORCL‑US) and Amazon’s five‑year CDS levels have also approached or hit high points, and other large tech firms see credit metrics affected by AI spend and financing demand. Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon stocks also fell that day, indicating the market is re‑evaluating capital allocation across the AI sector rather than reacting solely to Meta’s earnings.

Another focus of the double‑whammy is Meta’s creation of non‑voting Class C common stock. The board approved a capital‑structure adjustment on Oct 19, obtained shareholder written consent on Oct 20, and plans to implement it on Jan 19 2027. Under the plan, each existing Class A and Class B share will be allocated one Class C share, with the record and payment dates to be set by the board. Because Class C shares carry no voting rights, the move is expected to increase the company’s flexibility in using stock without altering the existing voting‑power structure.

The arrangement resembles a 2‑for‑1 stock split in form but is not the same. A typical split merely divides existing shares without changing ownership percentages or market‑cap. Meta’s Class C shares are a new, non‑voting class that can be used for employee compensation, acquisitions or capital raising, meaning the new shares could also become a tool for future external financing.

Investors worry that when free cash flow is negative and AI construction is accelerating, the new share structure could be a pre‑emptive step for future equity financing. The company could issue non‑voting shares without diluting Mark Zuckerberg’s voting control, yet a large issuance could still dilute existing shareholders’ economic interests. In other words, preserving voting control and avoiding equity dilution are separate issues.

Oppenheimer analysts estimate that by 2028 AI‑related and Muse investments could cut Meta’s cumulative free cash flow by about $135 billion, exceeding the roughly $90 billion of cash and marketable securities the company currently holds. This is a scenario‑based estimate, not an official cash‑flow forecast, but it reflects market concern that if capex stays above what operating cash can cover, Meta may need to rely more heavily on debt or equity financing.

Equity analysts and credit markets diverge mainly because they look at different time horizons. Equity investors focus on how much revenue and profit AI can generate over the next several years, while credit investors concentrate on near‑term payment obligations, bond supply and refinancing costs. As long as investors believe AI will boost ad efficiency and corporate value, the stock can stay supported despite short‑term spending pressure; bond investors, however, must first see that the company can meet upcoming cash‑outflows, not just rely on long‑term growth expectations to assess credit risk.

Some Wall Street houses remain bullish on Meta. Barclays kept its “overweight” rating and raised the price target from $780 to $880, and at least 13 firms lifted their targets after the earnings release. Citi sees Meta entering an AI “super‑cycle,” with upside arguments centred on Muse user growth, AI‑driven ad‑pricing improvements and the commercial potential of new products.

About a month and a half after launch, Muse had over 10 million North‑American users, providing an early foundation for Meta to explore AI‑assistant and new‑service business models. If such products drive more user engagement, increase ad monetisation or create new paid‑service revenue, the massive infrastructure commitments could become an investment that underpins long‑term competitiveness rather than a pure cost burden.

However, growing user numbers do not automatically translate into sufficient returns on the related investments. Meta still needs to prove that AI services can deliver sustained revenue growth and offset server depreciation, energy costs, data‑center leases and R&D spend. For shareholders, the key is not just whether AI products attract users, but whether the incremental revenue and profit can cover capital costs within a reasonable timeframe.

Technical price action also mirrors shifting market sentiment. Meta opened 2026 around $648.74, with Thursday’s intraday low of $648.26 barely retracing the year‑to‑date level. If the stock holds near $648, the market may view the drop as a valuation correction driven by AI‑spending concerns; a break below could test the $600 area. Conversely, a recovery would need to climb back to Wednesday’s close of $697.52. These levels are technical reference points, not deterministic forecasts.

Three indicators merit close watching. First, Meta’s yet‑to‑be‑released 2027 capex plan: if spending stays high, negative free cash flow could evolve from a one‑off to a longer‑term pressure. Second, whether the company issues new bonds soon, and on what size and rate terms, which will directly show how much financing the market is willing to provide and at what cost. Third, whether the roughly $121.4 billion of 2027 contract payments can be met with operating cash, existing assets and external financing without eroding liquidity.

Meta’s recent stock‑bond double‑whammy does not mean its ad business has lost its competitive edge. Q3 revenue grew 26% YoY, ad prices rose 14% YoY, and daily active users reached 3.64 billion, all indicating core‑business momentum. The real issue is that AI‑investment scale is now large enough to reshape how the market evaluates the company’s financial structure: free cash flow turned negative for the first time in 14 years, capex exceeded operating cash in a quarter, lease and contract commitments rose to $825 billion, and the new Class C share structure adds another potential financing avenue.

Thus, the market’s reaction is more a re‑pricing of Meta’s AI‑capital‑expenditure model than a wholesale denial of its operating outlook. Equity investors may still bet on long‑term ad‑efficiency gains and new‑product revenue from AI, while credit investors will first demand proof that cash flow in the coming years can cover spending and contractual obligations. Until the 2027 capex roadmap, bond‑issuance terms and AI‑investment returns become clearer, the gap between these two narratives will likely remain the main driver of Meta’s stock and credit‑spread volatility.

items.title: 4000破了下一步看哪？金價今夏漲幅吐光 本周恐創7月來最慘  專家：走勢反常原因成謎
items.title_en: Broken the $4,000 Barrier—What’s Next? Gold’s Summer Gains Wiped Out, This Week May Be the Worst Since July; Experts: The Cause of the Abnormal Trend Remains a Mystery
paras: 週五(23日)金價走軟，現貨黃金跌破每盎司4000美元關口，為7月來首見，日內跌0.6%，本週跌幅料將創下四個多月之最，因油價飆升以及表現強勁的美國經濟數據，加劇了市場對於Fed將維持高利率更長時間的預期。
高企的能源價格強化了Fed將維持高利率更長的預期，這增加了持有不產生收益的黃金的機會成本。上週美國初領失業救濟金人數降至近57年來最低水位，顯示10月就業成長出現溫和回升。市場焦點已轉向Fed下週二(27日)召開的政策會議，以及下週即將公佈的PCE數據。 PCE數據是Fed密切關注的關鍵指標。
專家則認為，金價與美元指數、美國公債殖利率之間的走勢明顯背離，令他難以判斷這輪拋售的真正原因。
獨立貴金屬分析師、BubbleBubble Report創辦人Jesse Colombo週四向《Kitco News》表示，他正在努力弄清黃金市場究竟發生了什麼，「走勢非常反常，美元指數正在下跌。通常情況下，在這樣的一天，你會預期美元指數上漲1%，但現在它反而下跌了15個基點」。
他也注意到，日元大幅走強。他認為，這可能意味著市場正在發生旨在推動日元升值的干預行動，而這通常會對美元構成利空。「通常情況下，這會推動貴金屬上漲，但貴金屬現在卻與美元一同下跌。當然，美元的跌幅並不算大。與此同時，債券殖利率正在下行，卻同樣沒有給貴金屬帶來提振。這種表現非常反常。」
原油價格略有上漲，但Colombo認為漲幅不足以解釋黃金這次下跌的幅度。
paras_en: On Friday (the 23rd) gold slipped, with spot prices falling below the $4,000‑per‑ounce level for the first time since July, down 0.6% intraday. The weekly decline is set to be the steepest in over four months, driven by soaring oil prices and strong U.S. economic data that have heightened expectations that the Fed will keep rates high for longer.

Higher energy prices have reinforced expectations that the Fed will maintain elevated rates for an extended period, raising the opportunity cost of holding non‑yielding gold. Last week U.S. initial jobless claims fell to the lowest level in nearly 57 years, indicating a modest rebound in October employment growth. Market focus has shifted to the Fed’s policy meeting on Tuesday (the 27th) and the upcoming PCE data, a key indicator the Fed watches closely.
Experts say the price movement of gold is clearly diverging from the U.S. dollar index and U.S. Treasury yields, making it difficult for them to pinpoint the true driver of the current sell‑off.

Independent precious‑metals analyst and BubbleBubble Report founder Jesse Colombo told Kitco News on Thursday that he is trying to figure out what’s happening in the gold market, noting “the trend is very abnormal – the dollar index is falling. Normally on a day like this you’d expect the dollar index to rise about 1%, but instead it dropped 15 basis points.”

He also observed that the yen has strengthened sharply, suggesting possible market intervention aimed at boosting the yen, which is usually bearish for the dollar. “Normally that would lift precious metals, but metals are falling alongside the dollar. The dollar’s drop isn’t large, and bond yields are falling too, yet they’re not supporting metals. The behavior is highly unusual,” he said.
Oil prices edged higher, but Colombo believes the increase is insufficient to explain the magnitude of gold’s recent decline.

items.title: 記憶體市場從「缺晶片」變「紅海」？黃仁勳：2029年供應過剩可能性不大
items.title_en: Memory Market Shifts from ‘Chip Shortage’ to ‘Red Sea’? Jensen Huang: Little Chance of Oversupply by 2029
paras: 記憶體晶片股過去一週因市場擔憂供應過剩和需求疲軟而遭遇拋售，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳週四(22日)表示，到2029年出現記憶體供應過剩的可能性不大。
黃仁勳在輝達柏林GTC大會期間受訪時說道，「記憶體很棒的一點是，你永遠可以用得更多。」他補充稱，HBM（高頻寬記憶體）未來數年會持續得到應用。
黃仁勳談到，「我們是全球首家將LPDDR記憶體——也就是手機中使用的記憶體——引入資料中心的公司，這使我們的能效達到目前全球任何方案的兩倍，因此我們將繼續大量使用這類記憶體。」
上週，南韓一家知名媒體發表專欄文章，呼籲南韓政府為AI熱潮降溫做好準備，隨後記憶體晶片股在過去一週遭受重挫。
專欄文章援引兩位專家的話稱，預計到2029年，半導體將出現「大量新增供應」，進而使記憶體市場變成「紅海」。他們寫道：「到2029年，超級週期可能結束，產業可能進入低迷期。」
記憶體是輝達晶片的核心組件，供應過剩可能導致價格下跌，並打擊SK海力士、三星和美光等製造商的利潤率。
隨著以晶片股為代表的科技股遭到猛烈拋售，輝達執行長黃仁勳近日頻繁發聲，為投資人注入「強心針」。他上週四表示，客戶對AI晶片的訂購需求持續超過公司的供應能力，新的訂單「幾乎每週、甚至每天」都在湧入。
在黃仁勳最新發聲之際，由於市場對AI公司支出的擔憂再次加劇，加上地緣政治緊張局勢升溫，週四美股科技板塊大跌，那斯達克綜合指數收跌2.6%。
記憶體概念股重挫，SanDisk(SNDK-US)下跌8.51%，SK海力士下跌8.07%，希捷科技(STX-US)下跌7.86%，威騰電子(WDC-US)下跌6.43%，美光科技(MU-US)下跌6.23%，Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM)下跌7.08%。
週四美股科技股重挫的部分原因，恰恰在於黃仁勳。他當天在柏林出席輝達GTC大會期間表示，AI運算需求極其旺盛，但資本短缺制約「新雲端服務商」的擴張。加上Meta(META-US)週三披露，未來支出承諾總額約為8,250億美元，共同引發外界對科技公司將發行更多債務，以資助AI基礎設施建設的擔憂。
與此同時，記憶體大廠威騰電子週四公布業績顯示，記憶體需求仍強勁。財報顯示，該公司第一季度淨營收為43.8億美元，年增55%，高於分析師預期的41.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘為4.64美元，也高於市場預期的4.10美元。
paras_en: Memory chip stocks were sold off last week amid market worries about oversupply and weak demand, and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday (the 22nd) that the likelihood of a memory oversupply by 2029 is low.

Huang told reporters during NVIDIA’s GTC conference in Berlin that “the great thing about memory is you can always use more of it.” He added that HBM (high‑bandwidth memory) will continue to find applications for several years to come.

Huang noted, “We are the world’s first company to bring LPDDR memory—the type used in smartphones—into data centers, which gives us twice the energy efficiency of any other solution globally, so we will keep using large amounts of this memory.”

Last week, a well‑known South Korean media outlet published an editorial urging the Korean government to prepare for a cooling of the AI boom, after which memory chip stocks suffered a sharp decline over the past week.

The editorial quoted two experts who said they expect “massive new supply” in semiconductors by 2029, turning the memory market into a “red sea.” They wrote, “By 2029 the super‑cycle may end and the industry could enter a downturn.”
Memory is a core component of NVIDIA’s chips, and an oversupply could push prices down and hit the profit margins of manufacturers such as SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron.

As chip‑related tech stocks faced heavy selling, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has been speaking frequently to give investors a “shot of adrenaline.” He said last Thursday that customer orders for AI chips continue to exceed the company’s supply capacity, with new orders “coming in almost every week, even every day.”
When Huang made his latest remarks, concerns over AI‑related spending resurfaced, geopolitical tensions rose, and U.S. tech stocks fell sharply on Thursday, sending the Nasdaq Composite down 2.6%.

Memory‑related stocks tumbled: SanDisk (SNDK-US) fell 8.51%, SK Hynix 8.07%, Seagate Technology (STX-US) 7.86%, Western Digital (WDC-US) 6.43%, Micron Technology (MU-US) 6.23%, and the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM) 7.08%.

One of the reasons for Thursday’s tech‑stock plunge was precisely Huang. While attending NVIDIA’s GTC in Berlin, he said AI compute demand is extremely strong, but a lack of capital limits the expansion of “new cloud service providers.” He also cited Meta’s (META-US) Wednesday disclosure of roughly $825 billion in future spending commitments, sparking worries that tech firms may need to issue more debt to fund AI infrastructure.

At the same time, memory giant Western Digital reported on Thursday that demand remains robust. The earnings release showed first‑quarter net revenue of $4.38 billion, up 55% year‑over‑year and above analysts’ $4.15 billion forecast; adjusted earnings per share were $4.64, also beating the market’s $4.10 expectation.

items.title: 「熊市陷阱」失靈！晶片股市值蒸發逾3兆美元 費半下一道防線在哪？
items.title_en: ‘Bear Market Trap’ Fails! Chip Stocks Lose Over $3 Trillion in Market Value, Where Is the Next Defense for the Philly Semiconductor Index?
paras: 外媒報導，美國晶片股賣壓再度加劇，費城半導體指數週四 (22 日) 重挫6.72%，收10,731.98點，跌破11,000點關卡，創6月以來最大單日跌幅，並寫下7月29日以來最低收盤紀錄。本週稍早的反彈格局遭到破壞後，200日均線及10,450至10,550點區間，成為接下來的重要支撐觀察指標。
《Yahoo Finance》統計，其追蹤的60檔晶片股自10月6日以來全數下跌，合計市值蒸發逾3兆美元，光是週四單日便縮水逾9,000億美元。
相較之下，那斯達克100指數同期約下跌7%，晶片股跌幅超過其2倍，顯示半導體族群承受更沉重的賣壓。
個股方面，科林研發 (LRCX-US) 與應用材料 (AMAT-US) 自10月6日以來均累跌約30%，超微 (AMD-US) 跌逾20%。輝達 (NVDA-US) 跌幅相對較小，但由於市值龐大，同期市值仍縮水逾6,000億美元。
科林研發週四重挫11.76%，成為晶片股領跌指標。該公司週三盤後雖公布創紀錄營收，卻表示供應限制壓抑業績展望，並預期12月當季中國市場銷售將「明顯下滑」。應用材料、超微及輝達週四也分別下跌8.16%、8.10%及4.40%。
分析指出，費半指數9月14日及10月16日均曾在約11,130點附近收盤，本週二再度下探這一帶後迅速反彈，一度形成「熊市陷阱」，也就是價格跌破支撐後快速回升，讓押注續跌的投資人措手不及。
然而，這項反彈訊號能否延續，取決於支撐能否持續守住。週四費半收盤跌破11,000點，意味先前止跌格局遭到破壞，市場焦點也轉向下方支撐。
報導指出，費半200日均線位於10,450至10,550點區間上方不遠處，週四盤中低點距離均線僅差數點。若這道均線失守，指數可能進一步測試約10,500點附近，也就是7月29日夏季漲勢起步的位置。
若要重建反彈格局，多頭首先須在未來幾個交易日推動費半重新收於11,000點之上。更上方則須留意12,600至12,700點壓力區，該區曾在8月與9月多次壓抑反彈。
儘管股價持續下挫，逢低買盤仍未退場。
彭博資深ETF分析師 Eric Balchunas 週四發文指出，半導體ETF過去一週吸引創紀錄資金流入，並表示，過往在這類跌勢中進場承接，往往有不錯的紀錄。
不過，資金流入尚未阻止股價下跌。
對晶片股多頭而言，短線關鍵仍在於費半能否守住200日均線，並儘速收復11,000點，才能重建反彈格局。
paras_en: Foreign media reported that selling pressure on U.S. chip stocks intensified again, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunging 6.72% on Thursday (the 22nd) to close at 10,731.98 points, breaking the 11,000‑point barrier and marking its biggest single‑day drop since June as well as the lowest close since July 29. After the earlier rebound pattern was destroyed, the 200‑day moving average and the 10,450‑to‑10,550 point range have become key support levels to watch.
Yahoo Finance tallied that the 60 chip stocks it tracks have all fallen since October 6, wiping out more than $3 trillion in market value, with Thursday alone erasing over $900 billion.
By comparison, the Nasdaq‑100 fell about 7% over the same period, meaning chip stocks lost more than twice as much, showing the semiconductor sector is bearing far heavier selling pressure.

At the individual stock level, Lam Research (LRCX‑US) and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) have each dropped roughly 30% since October 6, while AMD (AMD‑US) is down over 20%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) fell less in percentage terms, but its massive market cap still shrank by more than $600 billion during the same span.

Lam Research tumbled 11.76% on Thursday, becoming the leading laggard among chip stocks. The company had posted record revenue after hours on Wednesday but warned that supply constraints were curbing its outlook and that sales in China for the December quarter would “significantly decline.” Applied Materials, AMD and Nvidia also fell on Thursday, down 8.16%, 8.10% and 4.40% respectively.

Analysts noted that the Philly Semiconductor Index closed around 11,130 points on both September 14 and October 16, and after dipping into that area again on Tuesday this week it rebounded sharply, creating a “bear‑market trap” – a quick bounce after breaking support that caught short‑term bearish bets off guard.

However, whether that rebound can continue depends on whether support holds. Thursday’s close below 11,000 points means the previous bottom‑forming pattern was broken and market focus has shifted to lower‑level support.

The report said the 200‑day moving average sits just above the 10,450‑to‑10,550 point band, and Thursday’s intraday low was only a few points away from that average. If the average is breached, the index could test around 10,500 points, the level where the summer rally began on July 29.

To rebuild the rebound pattern, bulls first need to push the index back above 11,000 points in the coming trading days. Above that, attention should turn to the 12,600‑to‑12,700 point resistance zone, which throttled rebounds multiple times in August and September.
Despite the continued price decline, buying on dips has not disappeared.

Bloomberg senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas wrote on Thursday that semiconductor ETFs attracted record inflows last week and noted that historically, entering during such declines has often yielded solid returns.
Nevertheless, the inflows have not stopped the price drops.

For chip‑stock bulls, the short‑term key remains whether the Philly Semiconductor Index can hold the 200‑day moving average and quickly reclaim the 11,000‑point level to re‑establish a rebound framework.

items.title: 「像極了矽谷銀行那天！」 科技股血崩資金瘋搶美債 十年期殖利率摔破5%  黑天鵝序幕？
items.title_en: "Just Like the Silicon Valley Bank Day!" Tech Stocks Plunge as Funds Rush to US Treasuries, 10-Year Yield Falls Below 5% – A Black Swan Prelude?
paras: 美股科技股週四(22日)遭遇大規模拋售，資金轉進美債避險，「全球資產定價之錨」10年期美債殖利率應聲跌破5%大關，盤中一度重挫19.3個基點至4.952%，創2023年3月矽谷銀行危機以來單日最大跌幅紀錄。
美債反彈爆發點來自AI資本開支與融資鏈疑慮，Meta最新財報營收雖優於預期，但公司上調資本支出指引，並釋出大規模AI基礎建設融資計畫，自由現金流轉負，五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價升至歷史高位，顯示投資人擔心巨額債務、股權稀釋與回報時程，CoreWeave等「新雲」服務商債券殖利率與CDS維持高檔，黃仁勳提及資金短缺限制新雲擴張，進一步放大信貸市場不安。
PGIM Credit全球債券主管Robert Tipp指出，常態下幾個基點波動已算顯著，但週四幅度是平時三倍；Mackenzie Investments的Dustin Reid則認為，主線已從AI樂觀敘事切換為「賽道是否過熱、資本是否透支」，且法國政局動盪、中東局勢升溫與油價走高，也讓資金更傾向落袋為安。
短端利率同步反應：2年期美債殖利率一度跌18.8個基點至4.635%，市場對Fed持續升息的定價明顯降溫。對此，Tipp稱股市拋售若加劇、高油價拖垮實體需求，Fed後續升息空間將被壓縮，貨幣市場已不再完全反映年底前加息。
科技權重股成拋售重心，醫療保健、公用事業等防禦類股與低科技權重寬基ETF相對抗跌。CFRA首席策略師Sam Stovall提醒，科技類股佔標普500權重已近40%，市場正觀望「這只是回檔，還是全面去槓桿序幕」。
整體而言，AI融資擔憂、地緣風險與高利率預期共振，使美債再度發揮避險功能，後續關鍵在Meta等巨頭資本開支節奏、信貸市場是否持續承壓，以及Fed能否在通膨與金融穩定之間維持平衡。
paras_en: US tech stocks suffered a massive sell‑off on Thursday (the 22nd), prompting capital to flee into US Treasury bonds for safety. The "global asset‑pricing anchor," the 10‑year Treasury yield, promptly slipped below the 5% threshold, briefly dropping 19.3 basis points to 4.952% – the steepest single‑day decline since the Silicon Valley Bank crisis in March 2023.

The rebound in Treasuries was sparked by concerns over AI‑related capital spending and financing chains. Although Meta’s latest earnings beat expectations, the company raised its capital‑expenditure guidance and unveiled a large‑scale AI infrastructure financing plan, turning free cash flow negative. Five‑year credit‑default swap (CDS) spreads rose to historic highs, signalling investor worries about massive debt, equity dilution and return timelines. Bonds and CDS of "new‑cloud" providers such as CoreWeave remain elevated, and Nvidia’s Jensen Huang noted that funding shortages are curbing new‑cloud expansion, further amplifying credit‑market unease.

PGIM Credit’s global bond head Robert Tipp said that a few basis‑point moves are usually notable, but Thursday’s swing was three times the norm. Dustin Reid of Mackenzie Investments added that the narrative has shifted from AI optimism to questions of whether the sector is overheated and capital over‑drawn, while political turmoil in France, rising tensions in the Middle East and higher oil prices are pushing investors toward safety.

Short‑term rates reacted in tandem: the 2‑year Treasury yield fell 18.8 basis points to 4.635%, indicating a clear cooling of market pricing for further Fed hikes. Tipp warned that if equity sell‑offs intensify and high oil prices depress real‑economy demand, the Fed’s room for additional rate hikes will be squeezed, and money markets are no longer fully pricing in rate hikes through year‑end.

Technology‑heavy stocks bore the brunt of the sell‑off, while defensive sectors such as healthcare and utilities, as well as broad‑based low‑tech ETFs, held up better. CFRA chief strategist Sam Stovall cautioned that tech now accounts for nearly 40% of the S&P 500, and the market is watching to see whether this is merely a correction or the start of a broader deleveraging phase.

Overall, worries over AI financing, geopolitical risks and high‑rate expectations have revived Treasuries’ safe‑haven role. The next key factors will be the pace of capital spending by giants like Meta, whether credit markets remain under pressure, and whether the Fed can balance inflation control with financial stability.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉東台PCB鑽孔機接單滿載直達2027年底 周漲2成創近4個月新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Dongtai PCB Drilling Machines Fully Booked Through End of 2027, Shares Jump 20% to Four-Month High
paras: 工具機大廠東台(4526-TW)近期營運報捷，PCB 鑽孔機訂單看到明年底，在買盤強烈追捧下，10/21 股價亮燈漲停慶祝，10/22 盤中再拉第二根漲停(41.85元)，隨後雖遭到獲利調節賣壓使漲停打開，終場仍大漲 7.88% 收在 41.05 元，單日成交量一舉爆出 5.6 萬張巨量。儘管本周僅有 4 個交易日，累計漲幅已高達 20.38%，股價強勢刷新近 4 個月以來新高。
在AI伺服器與載板題材加持下，東台吸引短線資金與法人買盤同步進駐，儘管高檔爆量震盪導致漲停打開，但股價站穩 40 元大關，呈現「價漲量增」的強勢多頭格局，短線量能充沛成為支撐股價震盪向上重要的基石。
東台 2026年9月單月營收高達 7.07 億元，月增 66.52%、年增 81.03%，創 36 個月新高紀錄；今年前 9 月累計營收達 44.22 億元，年增 11.01%，顯現營運已擺脫底部、邁入高成長軌道。
於本周 10/20至10/22登場的 TPCA Show 2026 台灣電路板產業展，東台釋出樂觀的展望，會中展示「CCD 高精度鑽孔機」與「AMR 無人化鑽孔完整方案」，展現轉型系統整合商的成果。
東台指出，AI 基礎建設爆發帶動高階 PCB 與 IC 載板需求，鑽孔製程成為全球供應鏈關鍵瓶頸。東台已成功鎖定全球前 20 大高階 PCB 業者，打入台灣、中國及韓國等多家指標板廠供應鏈。公司透露，目前訂單能見度已一路直達 2027 年底，現有產能持續滿載，正全力擴充產能以應對龐大訂單的需求。
paras_en: Dongtai (4526‑TW), a major machine tool maker, recently reported strong operations as PCB drilling‑machine orders extend to the end of next year. Amid fierce buying pressure, the stock hit a limit‑up on October 21 and surged again during intraday trading on October 22, reaching NT$41.85. Although profit‑taking pressure later opened the limit‑up, the share closed up 7.88% at NT$41.05 with a massive one‑day volume of 56,000 lots. Despite only four trading days this week, the cumulative gain has already reached 20.38%, pushing the price to a four‑month high.

Riding the AI server and substrate themes, Dongtai attracted both short‑term speculative capital and institutional buying. Even though heavy volume at high levels caused the limit‑up to open, the stock held above the NT$40 mark, displaying a strong bullish pattern of rising price with increasing volume. Robust short‑term trading volume has become a key support for the stock’s upward oscillation.

In September 2026, Dongtai’s monthly revenue hit NT$707 million, up 66.52% month‑over‑month and 81.03% year‑over‑year, setting a 36‑month record. For the first nine months of the year, cumulative revenue reached NT$4.422 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 11.01%, indicating the business has moved out of the bottom and entered a high‑growth trajectory.

At the TPCA Show 2026 – Taiwan Printed Circuit Board Industry Exhibition held from October 20‑22, Dongtai presented an optimistic outlook, showcasing its “CCD high‑precision drilling machine” and “AMR unmanned drilling complete solution,” highlighting its transformation into a system‑integration provider.

Dongtai noted that the explosion of AI infrastructure is driving demand for high‑end PCBs and IC substrates, making the drilling process a critical bottleneck in the global supply chain. The company has secured contracts with the world’s top 20 high‑end PCB manufacturers, entering supply chains of key factories in Taiwan, China, and South Korea. It disclosed that order visibility now extends all the way to the end of 2027, current capacity remains fully utilized, and it is aggressively expanding capacity to meet the massive order demand.

items.title: 美光台中工會協商成功！8成人員調薪近2.7倍 經部盼桃園廠跟進
items.title_en: Micron Taichung Union Negotiation Successful! Over 80% of Staff Receive Salary Hikes of Nearly 2.7‑fold; Ministry Hopes Taoyuan Plant Will Follow Suit
paras: 美光 （MICR-US) 台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，約8成以上人員調薪近2.7倍，產線人員年薪提高至200多萬元，初階與中高階工程師年薪更分別上看400萬與600萬元，勞退提撥亦升至10%。經濟部昨（22）日晚間表示樂見雙方達成共識，並期盼桃園廠能持續溝通，共同創造雙贏。
針對美光公司與台中工會達成共識，經濟部昨日強調，政府肯定雙方共同努力，透過理性溝通共創雙贏。經濟部指出，台灣經濟成長得益於AI爆發，記憶體產業亦蓬勃發展，政府樂見公司提出更多好的方案來提升員工待遇、進行留才與攬才，同時也期盼桃園廠能夠持續溝通協商。
根據美光公司公布的最新方案，主要展現3項重要成果：
第一，約有8成以上人員調薪近2.7倍。其中，產線人員年薪從63萬元增加到200多萬元；初階工程師從145萬元增加到400萬元；中高階工程師則從200多萬元增加到600萬元。
第二，工會爭取到勞退雇主提撥調升至10%，優於業界標準。
第三，第一線產線輪班人員的日班輪班津貼增至原本的3倍，由1500元調整至4500元。
經濟部表示，美光公司投資台灣已30年，長年是台灣最重要且最大的外資之一，累積投資額已達1.6兆元。台灣與美光共同走過記憶體不景氣的時期，如今一同享受記憶體及晶片大爆發的榮景。台灣的企業和人才都是台灣的珍貴資產，需要勞資雙方共同努力，將台灣半導體優勢最大化，唯有讓員工安心打拚，企業的腳步才能走得更穩、更遠。
paras_en: Micron (MICR‑US) and the Taichung union have reached a labor‑management agreement, with more than 80% of employees receiving salary increases of about 2.7 times. Production‑line staff now earn over NT$2 million annually, while junior and senior engineers see annual salaries rise to roughly NT$4 million and NT$6 million respectively, and the statutory retirement contribution has been raised to 10%. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said yesterday evening it welcomed the consensus and hopes the Taoyuan plant will continue the dialogue to create a win‑win outcome.

Regarding the agreement between Micron and the Taichung union, the Ministry of Economic Affairs emphasized yesterday that the government approves of the joint effort, praising the rational communication that produced a win‑win result. The ministry noted that Taiwan’s economic growth is being driven by an AI boom and a flourishing memory‑chip sector, and it is pleased that the company is proposing better compensation packages to retain and attract talent, while also urging the Taoyuan plant to keep negotiating.
According to Micron’s latest proposal, three key outcomes are highlighted:

First, more than 80% of staff receive salary hikes of about 2.7 times. Production‑line workers see their annual pay rise from NT$630,000 to over NT$2 million; junior engineers increase from NT$1.45 million to NT$4 million; and senior engineers go from just over NT$2 million to NT$6 million.
Second, the union secured an increase in the employer’s contribution to the labor pension fund to 10%, which is above the industry standard.
Third, shift differentials for front‑line production staff have been tripled, with the day‑shift allowance rising from NT$1,500 to NT$4,500.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs noted that Micron has been investing in Taiwan for 30 years and is one of the island’s most important and largest foreign investors, with cumulative investments reaching NT$1.6 trillion. Taiwan and Micron have weathered memory‑chip downturns together and now share in the boom of memory and chip demand. The country’s enterprises and talent are precious assets, requiring joint effort from labor and management to maximize Taiwan’s semiconductor advantage; only by ensuring employees feel secure can companies move forward more steadily and farther.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉玉晶光攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術生產 周漲6.91%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Yujing Optical Teams Up with US‑based 3M to Advance Expanded Beam Optical Technology Production, Up 6.91% This Week
paras: 光學精密元件廠玉晶光(3406-TW)確定將攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術（Expanded Beam Optical, EBO）解決方案的研發、製造與產能擴充，3M對玉晶光以私募增資股款48.13億元已匯入，取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權，玉晶光股價22日收在1160元，周漲6.91%。。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光以精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。
玉晶光股價走勢呈現多頭排列，股價22日收在1160元，周漲6.91%，短線支撐在5日及10日線糾結的1095元。
paras_en: Optical precision component maker Yujing Optical (3406‑TW) confirmed it will partner with US‑based 3M to develop, manufacture and expand capacity for Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions. 3M has transferred a private‑placement capital injection of NT$4.813 billion to Yujing Optical, acquiring roughly 4.68% of its shares. Yujing Optical closed at NT$1,160 on the 22nd, up 6.91% for the week.

The large‑scale collaboration between Yujing Optical and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design and its global customer network with Yujing Optical’s precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale and high‑accuracy assembly expertise. Yujing Optical’s production team will fully support the mass production of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions and related optical interconnect modules.

Yujing Optical reported revenue of NT$2.672 billion for September 2026, a month‑over‑month decline of 1.75% but a year‑over‑year increase of 0.54%. For the January‑September 2026 period, revenue reached NT$19.631 billion, up 10.21% year‑over‑year. The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, delivered robust single‑quarter revenue of NT$7.816 billion, entering a historic high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year.
Yujing Optical’s stock price shows a bullish alignment, closing at NT$1,160 on the 22nd, up 6.91% for the week, with short‑term support around the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages at NT$1,095.

items.title: 下周觀盤重點、個股機會、以及該留意提防的風險

9月外銷訂單創歷史單月新高，AI伺服器、先進封裝、PCB與高速光通訊仍具產業成長動能；但基本面強，不代表所有AI股票都能抵抗估值修正。
操作主軸：先控風險，再找強勢股
不急著猜最低點，也不因為大跌就全面看空。優先觀察量縮止跌、相對抗跌、營收與訂單能見度明確的公司，採分批布局，不追急漲、不開高槓桿。
二、下週盤勢：三種情境與關鍵價位
依據今日收盤46,041點、盤中高低走勢及近期反彈壓力，以下價位屬於技術觀察區間與情境推演，並非已確認的支撐或保證的漲跌目標。
偏多情境
若成交量配合、電子權值股轉強，且反彈不再迅速遭遇賣壓，才有機會挑戰上檔短期均線壓力。若只是量縮反彈，仍應視為跌深修復，不宜直接認定行情反轉。
中性情境
46,000點附近反覆震盪
若賣壓逐步減輕、成交量下降，指數可能進入整理築底階段。重點是觀察低點是否逐漸墊高，以及電子股能否由少數權值股帶動擴散至中小型股。
偏空情境
有效跌破46,000點且持續放量
若權值股同步走弱、下跌家數擴大，應防範賣壓延伸至45,000～45,500點區域，並進一步觀察先前止跌紅K棒所形成的44,210～45,169點區間能否提供支撐。
技術面最重要的判斷： 今天的反轉長黑，代表短線多方尚未取得主導權。下週不能只看指數是否反彈，更要觀察反彈時的成交量、收盤位置、下跌家數及外資現貨買賣超。若反彈量縮、下跌量增，底部仍可能需要更多時間整理。
三、下週最值得追蹤的四大產業與個股機會
這一波選股重點，不是單純尋找跌幅最大的股票，而是尋找新訂單、新產能與未來獲利能見度，能夠逐步轉化為實際業績的公司。
1. 先進製程與半導體核心供應鏈
核心觀察

台積電（2330-TW）：AI晶片、先進製程與先進封裝需求仍是中長期主軸。第三季EPS為29.43元，2026年營收成長展望也獲公司上修。
觀察重點：法說展望、先進製程產能利用率、資本支出與毛利率。
操作方向：優先觀察拉回時是否有承接，不宜因長期基本面強就忽略短線估值風險。


2. AI伺服器PCB、載板與高階材料
成長擴散

欣興（3037-TW）：輝達擴充載板產能合作，預計2027年第二季起增加產能，2028年中達到滿載規劃。
金像電（2368-TW）、建榮（5340-TW）：可列入高階伺服器PCB與特殊玻纖材料的延伸觀察名單。
觀察重點：高階產品占比、客戶認證、擴產進度、毛利率及訂單轉營收速度。


風險：產業題材升溫不等於每家公司都已取得實質訂單；需確認產品規格、客戶與量產時程。
3. AI晶片測試、封裝與CPO光通訊
新消息催化

京元電子（2449-TW）：輝達將提供11億美元產能預訂預付款，支持美國測試設施建置，目標2027年4月開始大規模量產。
日月光投控（3711-TW）：旗下矽品將擴充CPO光學引擎產能，規劃2027年年中前提升至目前的15倍。
欣興（3037-TW）：同時受惠載板擴產合作，值得追蹤後續資本支出及產能利用率。


風險：產能預付款不等於立即認列的營收或獲利；新廠投產、設備驗證、折舊及良率均影響實際貢獻。
4. 玻璃基板、先進封裝材料與特化材料
中期追蹤

玻璃核心材料、高階CCL、低熱膨脹係數材料與先進封裝製程，值得追蹤技術驗證及量產進展。
可觀察具備特殊材料研發、客戶認證與實際擴產能力的供應商。
但在訂單、量產及獲利貢獻尚未明朗前，宜先列入觀察清單，不宜只因題材熱門就追高。


個股篩選優先順序
四、基本面數據：AI需求強，但不能忽略估值
目前最有參考價值的基本面訊號，是最新公布的9月外銷訂單。
9月外銷訂單
創歷史單月新高
年增率
連續20個月正成長
前9月累計訂單
10月官方預估區間
預估值，非實際結果
資料來源：經濟部2026年10月20日公布的9月外銷訂單統計與10月預估。
這些數據支持AI供應鏈的中期成長趨勢，但投資上仍要區分三件事：

產業需求成長： 訂單持續增加，代表需求有支撐。
公司獲利成長： 還要看產品組合、毛利率、折舊、費用與客戶集中度。
股票報酬： 還要看買進價格與市場已反映多少利多。


以台積電（2330-TW）為例，10月中旬FactSet調查的2028年EPS中位數約185.61元，平均值約185.98元，並非一致預估200元。若以EPS 200元、本益比20倍推算，股價確實是4,000元；但這是建立在獲利與估值都達標的假設情境，不能視為確定目標價。
五、下週五大風險：這些因素可能讓反彈再度受阻
1. AI資本支出龐大，市場開始要求獲利兌現
即使AI需求持續成長，市場仍會檢視雲端服務商的資本支出回收速度、融資成本及現金流。高負債AI業者若出現財務壓力，可能拖累整體科技股評價。
2. 10月27～28日聯準會利率決策
聯準會即將召開會議，市場須留意利率決策、通膨評估及主席談話。即使利率維持不變，若政策訊號偏鷹、長天期公債殖利率走高，仍可能壓抑高估值科技股。
3. 反彈遭賣壓壓制，底部尚未確認
今日盤中由紅翻黑，代表市場信心仍弱。若反彈無法突破短期均線、下跌時成交量又放大，應防範再次測底，而不是把每一次反彈都當成新一波多頭起漲。
4. 外資資金流向與融資去化
外資若持續調節大型電子股，容易壓抑指數；融資水位偏高的個股，也可能因追繳、停損而放大波動。ETF與退休基金資金雖可提供支撐，但不能視為指數一定不跌的保證。
5. 題材股估值過高與量產進度落差
CPO、玻璃基板、先進封裝等新興題材，可能先反映數年後的成長預期。若訂單延後、良率不如預期或擴產成本增加，即使產業方向正確，股價仍可能大幅修正。
六、下週實戰操作策略
建議每天追蹤的四個指標

指數： 46,000點附近是否止穩，以及反彈能否收復47,000～47,300點區域。
量價： 下跌量是否收斂、反彈量能是否回升。
籌碼： 外資現貨買賣超、台指期淨部位、融資餘額變化。
產業： 台積電、AI伺服器、PCB、測試及CPO相關公司的營收、訂單與資本支出進度。


以上觀察區間應依實際盤勢及最新成交數據動態調整，不能單憑單一價位決定買賣。
七、專業總結
我對下週台股的看法是：短線先防守，中期找機會，選股重於選市。
台灣9月外銷訂單創新高，加上輝達持續推動測試、載板與CPO供應鏈擴產，顯示AI產業的結構性需求仍在；但今日長黑也提醒我們，基本面利多並不能立即消除市場的風險偏好下降與估值修正壓力。
因此，下週不宜只因為股價跌深就全面搶反彈，也不必因為大跌就放棄所有中長期機會。較合理的做法是：

先確認指數止跌，再提高持股比重。
優先布局有實質訂單、營收成長及獲利能見度的AI供應鏈。
對高估值與純題材股提高風險要求，避免重倉追價。
保留資金彈性，分批操作，嚴控槓桿。


真正值得把握的機會，不是猜中最低點，而是在市場情緒仍不穩定時，找出基本面沒有惡化、股價卻已合理修正，且量價開始轉強的公司。

items.title: 《巴隆》：Meta拚提前籌資逾400億美元投入AI 波克夏成潛在買家
items.title_en: Baron: Meta Pushes to Raise Over $40 B Early for AI, Berkshire May Be Potential Buyer
paras: 《巴隆週刊》週四 (22 日) 報導，Meta (META-US) 為支應龐大的人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資，最快可能在未來幾週啟動至少 400 億美元的股權募資，搶在其他科技企業進場前取得資金。手握逾 3,500 億美元現金的波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 可能成為潛在買家，但目前並無雙方洽談或波克夏確定參與的消息。
Meta 加速籌資的背景，是 AI 支出與債務負擔持續增加。公司今年資本支出預估約 1,400 億美元，長期債務今年以來增加 220 億美元，達到 800 億美元，另有龐大的表外融資承諾。
投資人對 Meta 融資需求的疑慮，也推升其借貸成本。公司 30 年期債券殖利率已突破 7%，對信用評等達 AA 級的企業而言處於偏高水準。透過發行新股取得資金，可望降低公司對債務融資的依賴。
Meta 在週三提交的文件中指出，最快自 2026 年秋季起，未來數年可能需要籌措數千億美元。
公司形容，資本募集環境「日益嚴峻」，認為在更多企業吸收市場可用資金之前，提前籌資將是審慎之舉。
科技業的資金競爭正是考量之一。Anthropic 預計不久後提交首次公開發行 (IPO) 申請文件，並可能在感恩節前進行大規模上市募資，增加 Meta 提前行動的誘因。
為擴大股權融資空間，Meta 週三公布財報時宣布，將設立不具投票權的 C 類普通股。
祖克柏目前透過未上市的超級投票權股份，掌握約 60% 投票權，經濟持股比重則約為 14%。未來若發行無投票權新股籌資，可避免稀釋其投票權，但仍會稀釋原股東的經濟持股比重。
依規劃，Meta 將於 2027 年 1 月，按每持有 1 股配發 1 股新 C 類股的方式，將新股分配給現有股東，效果類似 1 股拆為 2 股。
華爾街起初因此預期，公司可能等到明年 1 月才啟動股權募資，但最新文件透露的資金需求，讓市場開始預期時程可能提前。
摩根大通分析師 Doug Anmuth 認為，Meta 越早完成股權募資越好，有助消除市場對潛在新股供給的疑慮。
他指出，即使在新 C 類股配發前，公司仍有空間進行大規模股權募資，而不至於明顯影響祖克柏的投票控制權。
Evercore 分析師 Mark Mahaney 則估計，Meta 未來 3 至 6 個月可能透過股權與債務融資，合計籌措 500 億至 1,000 億美元。
這項估算涵蓋不同融資管道，與報導提出至少 400 億美元的潛在股權募資規模不同。
至於潛在投資者，波克夏參與 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 募資的案例，可能成為 Meta 的參考。
今年 6 月，Alphabet 進行規模 850 億美元的股權募資，波克夏以較市價折讓 6% 的價格，買進合計 100 億美元的具投票權及無投票權股份。
報導分析， 阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 接替巴菲特出任執行長後，波克夏仍持有逾 3,500 億美元現金，尋找資金配置機會。Meta 目前股價相當於不到 20 倍的 2026 年預估每股盈餘，為科技七巨頭中估值較低的公司之一，獲利仍維持雙位數年增率，可能符合波克夏重視價格與企業獲利能力的投資取向。
不過，波克夏是否參與仍屬報導分析，Meta 也尚未公布此次募資的確切金額、時程或發行條件。Meta 週四股價下跌 6.98%，收每股 648.85 美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that Meta (META-US) may launch an equity raise of at least $40 billion within the next few weeks to fund its massive AI infrastructure investments, aiming to secure capital before other tech firms enter the market. Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US), which holds over $350 billion in cash, could be a potential buyer, though there are no reports of talks or confirmed participation from Berkshire at this time.

The backdrop to Meta’s accelerated fundraising is the continued rise in AI spending and debt burden. The company’s capital expenditures this year are projected at roughly $140 billion, while long‑term debt has risen by $22 billion to $80 billion, alongside a large off‑balance‑sheet financing commitment.

Investor concerns about Meta’s financing needs have also pushed up its borrowing costs. The yield on its 30‑year bond has broken 7%, a relatively high level for a company with an AA credit rating. Raising cash through a new equity issuance could reduce the firm’s reliance on debt financing.
In a filing submitted on Wednesday, Meta indicated that as early as the fall of 2026, it may need to raise several hundred billion dollars over the next few years.
The company described the capital‑raising environment as “increasingly challenging,” saying that securing funds ahead of other firms that will soak up market liquidity is a prudent move.

Competition for capital in the tech sector is a key consideration. Anthropic is expected to file for an IPO soon and may conduct a large public offering before Thanksgiving, adding incentive for Meta to act early.
To broaden its equity‑raising capacity, Meta announced on Wednesday, alongside its earnings release, that it will create a non‑voting Class C common share.

Zuckerberg currently controls about 60% of voting power through unlisted super‑voting shares, while his economic stake is roughly 14%. Issuing non‑voting new shares would avoid diluting his voting power but would still dilute existing shareholders’ economic interests.
According to the plan, in January 2027 Meta will distribute one new Class C share for each existing share held, effectively a 1‑for‑2 split.
Wall Street initially expected the company might wait until January next year to start an equity raise, but the latest filing’s funding needs have led the market to anticipate an earlier timeline.
JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth said the sooner Meta completes an equity raise, the better, as it would help allay market concerns about a potential new‑share supply.
He noted that even before the new Class C shares are allocated, the company still has room to conduct a large‑scale equity raise without materially affecting Zuckerberg’s voting control.
Evercore analyst Mark Mahaney estimates that over the next three to six months Meta could raise between $50 billion and $100 billion through a combination of equity and debt financing.
That estimate covers various financing channels and differs from the report’s suggestion of at least $40 billion in potential equity proceeds.
As for potential investors, Berkshire’s participation in Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) financing could serve as a reference for Meta.
In June, Alphabet carried out an $85 billion equity raise, and Berkshire bought $10 billion of voting and non‑voting shares at a 6% discount to market price.

The analysis notes that after Greg Abel succeeded Warren Buffett as CEO, Berkshire still holds over $350 billion in cash and is looking for allocation opportunities. Meta’s stock trades at less than 20 times its projected 2026 earnings per share, making it one of the lower‑valued among the seven big tech firms, with double‑digit annual profit growth, which may fit Berkshire’s focus on price and profitability.

Whether Berkshire will actually participate remains speculative; Meta has not disclosed the exact amount, timing or terms of the planned raise. Meta’s shares fell 6.98% on Thursday, closing at $648.85 per share.

items.title: 二次暴倉在即？7月剛被強平 9月又押錯方向　華爾街「AI股神」再陷倉位危機
items.title_en: Second Margin Call Looms? Forced Liquidation in July, Wrong Bet Again in September – Wall Street’s “AI Stock God” Faces Position Crisis
paras: 曾被華爾街捧為「AI股神」的25歲避險基金經理Leopold Aschenbrenner，旗下基金Situational Awareness今年7月遭遇強平危機後，9月初重建的AI股多頭倉位近期再度承压，市場關注其看漲選擇權部位是否面臨權利金歸零風險。
Aschenbrenner曾任OpenAI「超級對齊」團隊研究員，2024年發表165頁長文《Situational Awareness》預言AI算力將吞噬晶片、記憶體與電力，隨後在舊金山成立同名基金，獲矽谷與華爾街資金追捧。其策略始終明確，重押閃迪與美光等記憶體股，押注大模型訓練帶動HBM與企業級NAND需求。
上述策略在今年上半年大賺，基金年內報酬率一度達439%，資產規模衝上450億美元，但轉折發生在今年7月下旬。美股AI硬體族群出現約兩成技術性回檔，在約4倍融資槓桿下，股價跌兩成即意味本金清零，摩根大通等重量級經紀商發出追加保證金通知並收緊信貸額度，基金被迫低價拋售持倉。
13F文件顯示，截至6月底基金美股多頭約202億美元，其中持有閃迪約57億、美光約56億，兩股合佔逾半數，強平數日內基金淨值回撤約67%，大批核心部位以約五成折讓轉讓給城堡證券(Citadel)。諷刺的是，8月相關硬體股強勁反彈，他卻已出局。
在7月致歉信中，Aschenbrenner承諾移除槓桿、改以自有資金或全額支付期權操作。上月初，Aschenbrenner轉與經紀商Clear Street合作，投入數億美元權利金買入超微、英特爾、SK海力士、SanDisk、CoreWeave等看漲選擇權，最大虧損鎖定在權利金內，券商無法盤中強平。
但選擇權引入「時間」變數。自9月建倉以來，七檔核心標的平均回跌18.3%，CoreWeave跌逾三分之一，SK海力士與閃迪跌約四分之一，現貨持有者能「躺平」等解套，選擇權卻因遠離履約價、時間價值流失而迅速萎縮；若到期前未大漲，權利金將歸零。
市場分析指出，Situational Awareness的兩次危機並非產業判斷錯誤，而是二級市場博弈邏輯不同。當基金槓桿、持倉與到期結構暴露在明處，倉位本身會成為對手盤打壓流動性的依據。數學與程式面對的是規則固定的世界，盤面價格卻是資金期限與人性博弈的結果。
隨著下月中第三季13F持倉報告即將發布，市場將確認這批選擇權真實規模。無論數字為何，Aschenbrenner三個內二度「高台跳水」已成一則樣本：數據能推演產業遠方，但價格從來只反映當下人心。
paras_en: 25-year-old hedge fund manager Leopold Aschenbrenner, once hailed by Wall Street as the “AI Stock God,” saw his Situational Awareness fund hit a forced‑liquidation crisis in July; the AI‑long position he rebuilt in early September is now under pressure again, and the market is watching whether his bullish options exposure faces the risk of premium decay to zero.

Aschenbrenner previously worked on OpenAI’s “super alignment” team and in 2024 published a 165‑page paper titled “Situational Awareness” predicting that AI compute would devour chips, memory and power. He then launched a fund of the same name in San Francisco, attracting Silicon Valley and Wall Street capital. His strategy has been clear‑cut: heavily overweight memory‑chip makers such as Micron and SK Hynix, betting that large‑model training will drive demand for HBM and enterprise‑grade NAND.

The strategy paid off handsomely in the first half of the year, with the fund’s annual return soaring to 439% and assets swelling to $45 billion, but the tide turned in late July. The U.S. AI‑hardware sector suffered roughly a 20% technical pull‑back; with about 4‑times leverage, a 20% price drop meant the capital was wiped out. Major brokers such as JPMorgan issued margin calls and tightened credit lines, forcing the fund to sell holdings at distressed prices.

13F filings show that as of the end of June the fund’s U.S. long exposure was about $20.2 billion, including roughly $5.7 billion in Micron and $5.6 billion in SK Hynix – together more than half of the portfolio. Within days of the forced liquidation the fund’s net asset value fell about 67%, and large core positions were sold to Citadel at roughly a 50% discount. Ironically, the hardware stocks rebounded strongly in August, but Aschenbrenner was already out of the game.

In a July apology letter, Aschenbrenner pledged to remove leverage and fund options trades with his own capital or pay the full premium up front. In early September he partnered with broker Clear Street, spending several hundred million dollars in premiums to buy call options on AMD, Intel, SK Hynix, SanDisk, CoreWeave and others, capping any loss at the premium paid and preventing intraday forced liquidation by the broker.

However, options introduce a time dimension. Since the September build‑up, the seven core underlyings have fallen an average of 18.3%; CoreWeave is down more than a third, SK Hynix and Micron each about a quarter. While spot holders can wait for a rebound, the options have rapidly lost value as they moved away from the strike and shed time value; if the stocks do not surge before expiry, the premiums will evaporate to zero.

Analysts note that the two crises at Situational Awareness were not due to misreading the industry but to different dynamics in the secondary market. When a fund’s leverage, position size and expiry profile are exposed, the position itself becomes a lever for opponents to squeeze liquidity. Mathematics and code operate in a rule‑bound world, whereas market prices reflect the interplay of capital horizons and human psychology.

With the Q3 13F filing due next month, the market will soon see the true scale of these options. Whatever the numbers, Aschenbrenner’s two “high‑board dives” in a short span serve as a case study: data can forecast industry trends far ahead, but prices only ever mirror the sentiment of the moment.

items.title: 記憶體市場從「缺晶片」變「紅海」？黃仁勳：2029年供應過剩可能性不大
items.title_en: Memory Market Shifts from ‘Chip Shortage’ to ‘Red Sea’? Jensen Huang: Little Chance of Oversupply by 2029
paras: 記憶體晶片股過去一週因市場擔憂供應過剩和需求疲軟而遭遇拋售，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳週四(22日)表示，到2029年出現記憶體供應過剩的可能性不大。
黃仁勳在輝達柏林GTC大會期間受訪時說道，「記憶體很棒的一點是，你永遠可以用得更多。」他補充稱，HBM（高頻寬記憶體）未來數年會持續得到應用。
黃仁勳談到，「我們是全球首家將LPDDR記憶體——也就是手機中使用的記憶體——引入資料中心的公司，這使我們的能效達到目前全球任何方案的兩倍，因此我們將繼續大量使用這類記憶體。」
上週，南韓一家知名媒體發表專欄文章，呼籲南韓政府為AI熱潮降溫做好準備，隨後記憶體晶片股在過去一週遭受重挫。
專欄文章援引兩位專家的話稱，預計到2029年，半導體將出現「大量新增供應」，進而使記憶體市場變成「紅海」。他們寫道：「到2029年，超級週期可能結束，產業可能進入低迷期。」
記憶體是輝達晶片的核心組件，供應過剩可能導致價格下跌，並打擊SK海力士、三星和美光等製造商的利潤率。
隨著以晶片股為代表的科技股遭到猛烈拋售，輝達執行長黃仁勳近日頻繁發聲，為投資人注入「強心針」。他上週四表示，客戶對AI晶片的訂購需求持續超過公司的供應能力，新的訂單「幾乎每週、甚至每天」都在湧入。
在黃仁勳最新發聲之際，由於市場對AI公司支出的擔憂再次加劇，加上地緣政治緊張局勢升溫，週四美股科技板塊大跌，那斯達克綜合指數收跌2.6%。
記憶體概念股重挫，SanDisk(SNDK-US)下跌8.51%，SK海力士下跌8.07%，希捷科技(STX-US)下跌7.86%，威騰電子(WDC-US)下跌6.43%，美光科技(MU-US)下跌6.23%，Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM)下跌7.08%。
週四美股科技股重挫的部分原因，恰恰在於黃仁勳。他當天在柏林出席輝達GTC大會期間表示，AI運算需求極其旺盛，但資本短缺制約「新雲端服務商」的擴張。加上Meta(META-US)週三披露，未來支出承諾總額約為8,250億美元，共同引發外界對科技公司將發行更多債務，以資助AI基礎設施建設的擔憂。
與此同時，記憶體大廠威騰電子週四公布業績顯示，記憶體需求仍強勁。財報顯示，該公司第一季度淨營收為43.8億美元，年增55%，高於分析師預期的41.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘為4.64美元，也高於市場預期的4.10美元。
paras_en: Memory chip stocks were sold off last week amid market worries about oversupply and weak demand, and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday (the 22nd) that the likelihood of a memory oversupply by 2029 is low.

Huang told reporters during NVIDIA’s GTC conference in Berlin that “the great thing about memory is you can always use more of it.” He added that HBM (high‑bandwidth memory) will continue to find applications for several years to come.

Huang noted, “We are the world’s first company to bring LPDDR memory—the type used in smartphones—into data centers, which gives us twice the energy efficiency of any other solution globally, so we will keep using large amounts of this memory.”

Last week, a well‑known South Korean media outlet published an editorial urging the Korean government to prepare for a cooling of the AI boom, after which memory chip stocks suffered a sharp decline over the past week.

The editorial quoted two experts who said they expect “massive new supply” in semiconductors by 2029, turning the memory market into a “red sea.” They wrote, “By 2029 the super‑cycle may end and the industry could enter a downturn.”
Memory is a core component of NVIDIA’s chips, and an oversupply could push prices down and hit the profit margins of manufacturers such as SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron.

As chip‑related tech stocks faced heavy selling, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has been speaking frequently to give investors a “shot of adrenaline.” He said last Thursday that customer orders for AI chips continue to exceed the company’s supply capacity, with new orders “coming in almost every week, even every day.”
When Huang made his latest remarks, concerns over AI‑related spending resurfaced, geopolitical tensions rose, and U.S. tech stocks fell sharply on Thursday, sending the Nasdaq Composite down 2.6%.

Memory‑related stocks tumbled: SanDisk (SNDK-US) fell 8.51%, SK Hynix 8.07%, Seagate Technology (STX-US) 7.86%, Western Digital (WDC-US) 6.43%, Micron Technology (MU-US) 6.23%, and the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM) 7.08%.

One of the reasons for Thursday’s tech‑stock plunge was precisely Huang. While attending NVIDIA’s GTC in Berlin, he said AI compute demand is extremely strong, but a lack of capital limits the expansion of “new cloud service providers.” He also cited Meta’s (META-US) Wednesday disclosure of roughly $825 billion in future spending commitments, sparking worries that tech firms may need to issue more debt to fund AI infrastructure.

At the same time, memory giant Western Digital reported on Thursday that demand remains robust. The earnings release showed first‑quarter net revenue of $4.38 billion, up 55% year‑over‑year and above analysts’ $4.15 billion forecast; adjusted earnings per share were $4.64, also beating the market’s $4.10 expectation.

items.title: 「熊市陷阱」失靈！晶片股市值蒸發逾3兆美元 費半下一道防線在哪？
items.title_en: ‘Bear Market Trap’ Fails! Chip Stocks Lose Over $3 Trillion in Market Value, Where Is the Next Defense for the Philly Semiconductor Index?
paras: 外媒報導，美國晶片股賣壓再度加劇，費城半導體指數週四 (22 日) 重挫6.72%，收10,731.98點，跌破11,000點關卡，創6月以來最大單日跌幅，並寫下7月29日以來最低收盤紀錄。本週稍早的反彈格局遭到破壞後，200日均線及10,450至10,550點區間，成為接下來的重要支撐觀察指標。
《Yahoo Finance》統計，其追蹤的60檔晶片股自10月6日以來全數下跌，合計市值蒸發逾3兆美元，光是週四單日便縮水逾9,000億美元。
相較之下，那斯達克100指數同期約下跌7%，晶片股跌幅超過其2倍，顯示半導體族群承受更沉重的賣壓。
個股方面，科林研發 (LRCX-US) 與應用材料 (AMAT-US) 自10月6日以來均累跌約30%，超微 (AMD-US) 跌逾20%。輝達 (NVDA-US) 跌幅相對較小，但由於市值龐大，同期市值仍縮水逾6,000億美元。
科林研發週四重挫11.76%，成為晶片股領跌指標。該公司週三盤後雖公布創紀錄營收，卻表示供應限制壓抑業績展望，並預期12月當季中國市場銷售將「明顯下滑」。應用材料、超微及輝達週四也分別下跌8.16%、8.10%及4.40%。
分析指出，費半指數9月14日及10月16日均曾在約11,130點附近收盤，本週二再度下探這一帶後迅速反彈，一度形成「熊市陷阱」，也就是價格跌破支撐後快速回升，讓押注續跌的投資人措手不及。
然而，這項反彈訊號能否延續，取決於支撐能否持續守住。週四費半收盤跌破11,000點，意味先前止跌格局遭到破壞，市場焦點也轉向下方支撐。
報導指出，費半200日均線位於10,450至10,550點區間上方不遠處，週四盤中低點距離均線僅差數點。若這道均線失守，指數可能進一步測試約10,500點附近，也就是7月29日夏季漲勢起步的位置。
若要重建反彈格局，多頭首先須在未來幾個交易日推動費半重新收於11,000點之上。更上方則須留意12,600至12,700點壓力區，該區曾在8月與9月多次壓抑反彈。
儘管股價持續下挫，逢低買盤仍未退場。
彭博資深ETF分析師 Eric Balchunas 週四發文指出，半導體ETF過去一週吸引創紀錄資金流入，並表示，過往在這類跌勢中進場承接，往往有不錯的紀錄。
不過，資金流入尚未阻止股價下跌。
對晶片股多頭而言，短線關鍵仍在於費半能否守住200日均線，並儘速收復11,000點，才能重建反彈格局。
paras_en: Foreign media reported that selling pressure on U.S. chip stocks intensified again, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunging 6.72% on Thursday (the 22nd) to close at 10,731.98 points, breaking the 11,000‑point barrier and marking its biggest single‑day drop since June as well as the lowest close since July 29. After the earlier rebound pattern was destroyed, the 200‑day moving average and the 10,450‑to‑10,550 point range have become key support levels to watch.
Yahoo Finance tallied that the 60 chip stocks it tracks have all fallen since October 6, wiping out more than $3 trillion in market value, with Thursday alone erasing over $900 billion.
By comparison, the Nasdaq‑100 fell about 7% over the same period, meaning chip stocks lost more than twice as much, showing the semiconductor sector is bearing far heavier selling pressure.

At the individual stock level, Lam Research (LRCX‑US) and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) have each dropped roughly 30% since October 6, while AMD (AMD‑US) is down over 20%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) fell less in percentage terms, but its massive market cap still shrank by more than $600 billion during the same span.

Lam Research tumbled 11.76% on Thursday, becoming the leading laggard among chip stocks. The company had posted record revenue after hours on Wednesday but warned that supply constraints were curbing its outlook and that sales in China for the December quarter would “significantly decline.” Applied Materials, AMD and Nvidia also fell on Thursday, down 8.16%, 8.10% and 4.40% respectively.

Analysts noted that the Philly Semiconductor Index closed around 11,130 points on both September 14 and October 16, and after dipping into that area again on Tuesday this week it rebounded sharply, creating a “bear‑market trap” – a quick bounce after breaking support that caught short‑term bearish bets off guard.

However, whether that rebound can continue depends on whether support holds. Thursday’s close below 11,000 points means the previous bottom‑forming pattern was broken and market focus has shifted to lower‑level support.

The report said the 200‑day moving average sits just above the 10,450‑to‑10,550 point band, and Thursday’s intraday low was only a few points away from that average. If the average is breached, the index could test around 10,500 points, the level where the summer rally began on July 29.

To rebuild the rebound pattern, bulls first need to push the index back above 11,000 points in the coming trading days. Above that, attention should turn to the 12,600‑to‑12,700 point resistance zone, which throttled rebounds multiple times in August and September.
Despite the continued price decline, buying on dips has not disappeared.

Bloomberg senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas wrote on Thursday that semiconductor ETFs attracted record inflows last week and noted that historically, entering during such declines has often yielded solid returns.
Nevertheless, the inflows have not stopped the price drops.

For chip‑stock bulls, the short‑term key remains whether the Philly Semiconductor Index can hold the 200‑day moving average and quickly reclaim the 11,000‑point level to re‑establish a rebound framework.

items.title: 沃爾瑪創1999年來最佳單月 必需消費股創紀錄大漲是警訊嗎？
items.title_en: Walmart Posts Best Single-Month Gain Since 1999; Is the Record Surge in Consumer Staples a Warning Sign?
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，沃爾瑪(Walmart)(WMT-US)10月以來上漲16.2%，有望創下1999年以來最佳單月表現。而且這並非個案。本月在華爾街，牙膏、洗衣精與汽水的表現都勝過AI概念股，而且優勢相當懸殊。

必需消費品類股ETF Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund(XLP-US) 10月以來上漲11.3%，有望創下該基金自1998年12月成立以來最佳單月表現。同時，SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust(SPY-US)大致持平，Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund(XLK-US)則下跌6.9%。追蹤晶片製造商的iShares Semiconductor ETF(SOXX-US)更重挫逾15%。
這使必需消費品類股單月領先標普500指數約11個百分點。在這檔基金27年的歷史中，只有2022年4月曾出現如此大的差距。
那麼，為什麼投資人紛紛買進洗髮精與穀片相關股票？更重要的是，他們是否預見了即將到來的風險？
AI交易熱潮正失去吸引力
Meta Platforms(META-US)週四因市場擔憂其人工智慧支出而下跌約8%。受此影響，科技類股ETF XLK下跌3.4%，消費必需品類股ETF XLP則上漲2.7%。
美國10年期公債殖利率下跌約17個基點至4.95%，創下2024年8月2日以來最大的單日跌幅。
資金撤離其實更早就已開始。截至10月16日當週，美國銀行客戶賣出創紀錄的148億美元美國個股。
美銀全球研究部股票量化策略師Jill Carey Hall在報告中表示，「客戶賣出了11個產業中8個產業的股票，其中以科技股為首，資金流出規模更是史上第二大。」
消費必需品類股則是少數仍獲客戶買進的產業之一。
防禦型類股也可能過度擁擠
美國銀行的股票衍生性商品團隊，包括策略師Abhinandan Deb，並不認為這代表科技股崩盤的開始。
該團隊本週在報告中將AI概念股的拋售形容為，「主要是AI交易中邊緣領域受到持倉布局影響而出現的短暫波動，而非核心業務出現長期性疲弱的證據。」
他們表示，「市場承壓時，美股持續出現劇烈的類股輪動，而非市場結構破裂；近期防禦型類股相較科技股的優異表現，從歷史角度來看已極為極端。」
然而，這種輪動本身也存在風險。分析師補充指出：「看似矛盾的是，醫療保健與消費必需品等防禦型類股，如今也位於市場泡沫風險指標（BRI）偏高的區域。」投資人對消費必需品類股的買進，並非只集中在少數公司，而是廣泛發生於整個產業。
寶僑自1998年來未曾出現如此強勁單月表現
寶僑(PG-US)週四公布2027會計年度第一季財報後，股價上漲5.9%。
旗下擁有Tide洗衣精與Gillette刮鬍產品的寶僑，10月以來已上漲14.6%，有望創下1998年10月以來最佳單月表現。當時該股單月大漲24.7%。
寶僑核心獲利成長1%，每股達2美元；淨銷售額成長4%，達232.8億美元；銷量成長2.4%。公司也維持2027會計年度核心獲利展望不變。
不過，寶僑預期，本會計年度稅後原物料成本將帶來約14億美元的不利影響。財務長表示，由於油價因素，第二季及下半年的成本壓力將明顯加劇。
在歷史上，先前七次消費必需品類股出現如此強勁的單月表現，其中五次發生於2000年與2001年。當時，投資人在2001年3月開始的經濟衰退前，紛紛撤離網路泡沫時期的熱門贏家股。
在這七個案例中，有五次標普500指數在一年後處於下跌狀態。然而，這次有一個關鍵差異。
過去每一次出現上述情況時，標普500指數本身都下跌了1.6%至9.5%。但今年10月，SPY大致持平，且目前僅比本月創下的盤中歷史高點低約2.5%。換句話說，資金正在一個接近高點的市場內部輪動。
最接近的先例發生在不久前的2026年2月。當時XLP上漲7.8%，SPY則下跌0.9%；六個月後，SPY上漲了11.8%。
預測市場尚未認為經濟衰退迫在眉睫
Polymarket交易者認為，美國在2026年底前陷入經濟衰退的機率為7.5%，到2027年底前的機率則為35%。
這次創紀錄的單月表現所反映的，是投資人多麼渴望降低AI交易帶來的風險。上一次投資人出現如此強烈的避險需求，是在2000年與2001年，當時隨後迎來了空頭市場與經濟衰退。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Walmart (WMT-US) has risen 16.2% since October, on track for its best single‑month performance since 1999. Moreover, this isn’t an isolated case – this month on Wall Street, toothpaste, laundry detergent and soda have all outperformed AI‑related stocks, and by a wide margin.

The consumer‑staples sector ETF, Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLP-US), is up 11.3% since October, poised to record its best month since the fund’s inception in December 1998. At the same time, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY-US) is roughly flat, while the Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK-US) has fallen 6.9%. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US), which tracks chip makers, has slumped more than 15%.
This means consumer‑staples stocks have outpaced the S&P 500 by about 11 percentage points for the month. In the fund’s 27‑year history, only April 2022 saw a gap this large.
So why are investors piling into shampoo and cereal‑related stocks? More importantly, are they foreseeing an imminent risk?
